--!strict
-- Editor restoration only. The authored Instances, including deletions, remain authoritative.
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ManualScene = {}

function ManualScene.IsTarget(map: Instance?): boolean
	return map ~= nil
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
		and map:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
end

local function apply(part: MeshPart, template: MeshPart)
	local frame, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
	local texture, color, material = part.TextureID, part.Color, part.Material
	local transparency, shadow = part.Transparency, part.CastShadow
	part:ApplyMesh(template)
	part.CFrame, part.Size = frame, size
	part.TextureID, part.Color, part.Material = texture, color, material
	part.Transparency, part.CastShadow = transparency, shadow
end

function ManualScene.RestoreEdit(): any
	assert(RunService:IsStudio() and not RunService:IsRunning(), "Stopped Studio Edit required")
	assert(game.Name == "Children_of_corn_B.rbxl", "Exact B file required")
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	assert(ManualScene.IsTarget(map), "B manual scene required")
	assert(map and map:IsA("Model"), "Manual scene Model missing")
	local function current()
		assert(
			not RunService:IsRunning()
				and map.Parent == workspace
				and workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap") == map
				and ManualScene.IsTarget(map),
			"Editor restoration interrupted by Play or map change"
		)
	end
	local folder = assert(map:FindFirstChild("CornAuthoring"), "Authored plants missing")
	assert(
		folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and folder:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1,
		"Foreign corn preserved"
	)
	local appearance = require(script.Parent.CornAppearance)
	local templates = appearance.DetailedTemplates()
	current()
	local count, restored = 0, 0
	for _, part in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
			assert(
				part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
				"Foreign plant preserved"
			)
			local variety = part:GetAttribute("CornGreenVariety")
			assert(
				type(variety) == "number" and variety % 1 == 0 and variety >= 1 and variety <= 4,
				"Unknown plant variety preserved"
			)
			current()
			if part.MeshContent.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.None then
				apply(part, templates.Near[variety])
				restored += 1
			end
			count += 1
			if count % 256 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end
	end
	local beds = map:FindFirstChild("GreenBedEditor")
	local soilRestored = 0
	if beds then
		local geometry = require(script.Parent.GreenBedGeometry)
		local soil = geometry.BuildTemplates()
		current()
		for index, part in beds:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
				assert(
					part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner") == "corn_B_green_beds_v1",
					"Foreign soil preserved"
				)
				local key = part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryKey")
				assert(type(key) == "string" and soil[key], "Unknown soil preserved")
				current()
				if part.MeshContent.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.None then
					apply(part, soil[key])
					soilRestored += 1
				end
			end
			if index % 128 == 0 then
				task.wait()
			end
		end
	end
	local server = game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("GameServer")
	assert(server and server:FindFirstChild("Game"), "Project server modules required")
	current()
	local farm = require(server.Game.FarmGeometry).Ensure()
	current()
	-- A previous MCP Edit inspection may have required the old Source. A private
	-- clone avoids that cache without adding any temporary script to the scene.
	local module = server.Game.HarvestWorld:Clone()
	local ok, harvest = pcall(function()
		return require(module).Ensure()
	end)
	module:Destroy()
	assert(ok, harvest)
	current()
	return {
		plants = count,
		restoredCorn = restored,
		restoredSoil = soilRestored,
		farm = farm,
		harvest = harvest,
	}
end

return table.freeze(ManualScene)

--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Manual = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").GameShared.Game.ManualScene)
local Service = { Name = "ManualSceneService", Order = 10 }

function Service:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio() and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
	if not self._enabled then
		return
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if not Manual.IsTarget(map) then
		return
	end
	assert(map, "Manual scene missing")
	local corn = assert(map:FindFirstChild("CornAuthoring"), "Authored corn folder required")
	local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	assert(
		not storage:FindFirstChild("BManualEditorSources"),
		"Existing editor source pool preserved"
	)
	local pool = Instance.new("Folder")
	pool.Name = "BManualEditorSources"
	pool:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	pool:SetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion", 1)
	pool.Parent = storage
	local source = Instance.new("Folder")
	source.Name = "CornAuthoring"
	source:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	source:SetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion", 1)
	source:SetAttribute("BManualServerReady", false)
	source.Parent = pool
	local count = 0
	-- Transfer small existing chunks instead of updating visibility on every
	-- plant. ReplicatedStorage retains authored values and does not render art.
	for index, chunk in corn:GetChildren() do
		assert(
			chunk:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
			"Foreign authored chunk"
		)
		count += if chunk:IsA("BasePart") then 1 else #chunk:GetDescendants()
		chunk.Parent = source
		if index % 24 == 0 then
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	for index, item in map:GetDescendants() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			if item:GetAttribute("BAuthoringHelper") == true then
				item.Transparency = 1
				item.CanCollide, item.CanTouch, item.CanQuery = false, false, false
			end
		elseif item:IsA("BillboardGui") and item:GetAttribute("BAuthoringHelper") == true then
			item.Enabled = false
		end
		if index % 512 == 0 then
			task.wait()
		end
	end
	source:SetAttribute("BManualServerReady", true)
	print("[ManualSceneService] Authored B plants ready:", count)
end

return Service

--!strict
-- Edit placements are the B map source. Missing plants are never regenerated.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Layout = require(modules:WaitForChild("CornLayout"))
local Appearance = require(modules:WaitForChild("CornAppearance"))
local Controller = { Name = "AuthoringCornController", Order = 46 }
local PROJECT, OWNER = "children_of_corn", "corn_B_manual_authoring_v1"
local CLONE_BUDGET, TIME_BUDGET = 18, 0.002
local INDEX_BUDGET, INDEX_TIME = 512, 0.002
local NEAR_CAP, FAR_CAP, RECORD_CAP = 8064, 30000, 100000
local DENSE_RADIUS, RADIUS, RETAIN = 60, 130, 148

local function finite(value)
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function validSize(size)
	return finite(size.X)
		and finite(size.Y)
		and finite(size.Z)
		and size.X > 0
		and size.Y > 0
		and size.Z > 0
end

local function validFrame(frame)
	for _, value in { frame:GetComponents() } do
		if not finite(value) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function target()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local source = Layout.AuthoringSource(map)
	local field = map and map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	if
		map
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
		and map:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
		and source
		and source:IsA("Folder")
		and source:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and source:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
		and source:GetAttribute("BManualServerReady") == true
		and field
		and field:IsA("BasePart")
		and validFrame(field.CFrame)
	then
		return map, source, field
	end
	return nil, nil, nil
end

local function stamp(item)
	item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	item:SetAttribute("BManualCornRuntimeOwner", OWNER)
end

local function ownedTree(root)
	if root:GetAttribute("BManualCornRuntimeOwner") ~= OWNER then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in root:GetDescendants() do
		if item:GetAttribute("BManualCornRuntimeOwner") ~= OWNER then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Controller:_warn(message)
	if self._warning ~= message then
		self._warning = message
		warn("[AuthoringCornController] " .. message)
	end
end

function Controller:_clear(restoreSources)
	self._epoch += 1
	for _, connection in self._sourceConnections or {} do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._sourceConnections = {}
	for part, previous in self._hidden do
		if part.Parent and part.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1 then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = previous
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._hidden)
	if restoreSources ~= false and self._source and self._source:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
		for _, part in self._source:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
				local opacity = part:GetAttribute("BManualSourceTransparency")
				-- The server owns only its one startup write of exactly one.
				if
					type(opacity) == "number"
					and finite(opacity)
					and opacity >= 0
					and opacity <= 1
					and part.Transparency == 1
				then
					part.Transparency = opacity
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, folder in { self._nearFolder, self._farFolder } do
		if folder and folder.Parent then
			if folder:GetAttribute("BManualCornRuntimeOwner") == OWNER then
				folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
			end
			if ownedTree(folder) then
				folder:Destroy()
			else
				self:_warn("Foreign runtime content was preserved; author placements restored")
			end
		end
	end
	self._map, self._source, self._field = nil, nil, nil
	self._nearFolder, self._farFolder = nil, nil
	self._nodes, self._templates = nil, nil
	self._records, self._buckets, self._far, self._chunks = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self._nearByRecord, self._queue = {}, {}
	self._nearCount, self._farIndex, self._index = 0, 1, 1
	self._ready, self._preparing = false, false
	self._waiting, self._dirty, self._quiet, self._settleAge = false, false, 0, 0
end

function Controller:_begin(map, source, field)
	self:_clear(false)
	assert(
		not map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants") and not map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"),
		"Existing runtime layers were preserved"
	)
	self._map, self._source, self._field = map, source, field
	self._fieldFrame, self._fieldSize = field.CFrame, field.Size
	self._width = Layout.SpacingFor(field) * Layout.ChunkCells
	assert(finite(self._width) and self._width > 0, "Invalid authored corn chunk width")
	self._waiting, self._quiet, self._settleAge = true, 0, 0
	local function changed()
		if self._source == source then
			if not self._dirty then
				self._settleAge = 0
			end
			self._dirty, self._quiet = true, 0
		end
	end
	self._sourceConnections = {
		source.DescendantAdded:Connect(changed),
		source.DescendantRemoving:Connect(changed),
	}
	self._preparing = true
	local epoch = self._epoch
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, templates = pcall(Appearance.DetailedTemplates)
		if self._epoch ~= epoch then
			return
		end
		self._preparing = false
		if ok then
			self._templates = templates
		else
			self._failedSource = source
			self:_clear()
			self:_warn("Authored corn retained: " .. tostring(templates))
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_startSnapshot()
	self._nodes = self._source:GetDescendants()
	assert(#self._nodes <= RECORD_CAP + 10000, "Authoring snapshot exceeds its bounded inventory")
	self._waiting, self._dirty, self._index, self._settleAge = false, false, 1, 0
end

function Controller:_record(part)
	local transparency = part:GetAttribute("BManualSourceTransparency")
	if type(transparency) ~= "number" then
		transparency = part.Transparency
	end
	assert(
		finite(transparency) and transparency >= 0 and transparency <= 1,
		"Authored plant transparency is invalid"
	)
	if transparency >= 1 then
		return
	end
	local variety = part:GetAttribute("CornGreenVariety")
	local offset, templateSize =
		part:GetAttribute("HarvestRootOffset"), part:GetAttribute("CornGreenTemplateSize")
	assert(
		type(variety) == "number" and variety % 1 == 0 and variety >= 1 and variety <= 4,
		"Authored plant needs CornGreenVariety 1..4"
	)
	assert(
		typeof(offset) == "Vector3"
			and finite(offset.X)
			and finite(offset.Y)
			and finite(offset.Z)
			and typeof(templateSize) == "Vector3"
			and validSize(templateSize)
			and validSize(part.Size)
			and validFrame(part.CFrame)
			and #part:GetChildren() == 0,
		"Authored plant has invalid geometry metadata or foreign children"
	)
	assert(
		part.Anchored and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery,
		"Authored corn must remain static decorative art"
	)
	assert(#self._records < RECORD_CAP, "Authored corn record cap exceeded")
	local size, frame = part.Size, part.CFrame
	local scaled = Vector3.new(
		offset.X * size.X / templateSize.X,
		offset.Y * size.Y / templateSize.Y,
		offset.Z * size.Z / templateSize.Z
	)
	local root = frame:PointToWorldSpace(-scaled)
	local localRoot = self._fieldFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root)
	local spacing = Layout.SpacingFor(self._field)
	local column, row = part:GetAttribute("CornAuthorColumn"), part:GetAttribute("CornAuthorRow")
	if type(column) ~= "number" or not finite(column) or column % 1 ~= 0 then
		column = math.floor(localRoot.X / spacing + 0.5)
	end
	if type(row) ~= "number" or not finite(row) or row % 1 ~= 0 then
		row = math.floor(localRoot.Z / spacing + 0.5)
	end
	local record = {
		Source = part,
		Frame = frame,
		Size = size,
		Variety = variety,
		Root = root,
		Column = column,
		Row = row,
		Index = #self._records + 1,
		Transparency = transparency,
	}
	table.insert(self._records, record)
	local x, z = math.floor(localRoot.X / self._width), math.floor(localRoot.Z / self._width)
	local key = x .. ":" .. z
	local bucket = self._buckets[key]
	if not bucket then
		bucket = { Key = key, X = x, Z = z, Records = {} }
		self._buckets[key] = bucket
	end
	table.insert(bucket.Records, record)
	if column % 2 == 0 and row % 2 == 0 then
		assert(#self._far < FAR_CAP, "Authored stride-two backdrop exceeds 30000 plants")
		table.insert(self._far, record)
	end
end

function Controller:_hide(part)
	if self._hidden[part] == nil then
		self._hidden[part] = part.LocalTransparencyModifier
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end
end

function Controller:_publishSnapshot()
	local map = self._map
	assert(
		not map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants") and not map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"),
		"Existing runtime layers were preserved"
	)
	local near, far = Instance.new("Folder"), Instance.new("Folder")
	near.Name, far.Name = "CornClientPlants", "CornClientBackdrop"
	stamp(near)
	stamp(far)
	near:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	far:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
	far:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
	far:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	far:SetAttribute("DetailStride", Layout.SpacingFor(self._field) * 2)
	far:SetAttribute("MaxPlants", FAR_CAP)
	near:SetAttribute("NearPlantCap", NEAR_CAP)
	near:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	far:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	self._nearFolder, self._farFolder = near, far
	near.Parent, far.Parent = map, map
	if not self._source:IsDescendantOf(ReplicatedStorage) then
		for _, record in self._records do
			if record.Source.Transparency < 1 then
				self:_hide(record.Source)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, name in { "EditorPreview", "EditorFieldOverview" } do
		local folder = map:FindFirstChild(name)
		local attribute = if name == "EditorPreview"
			then "CornEditorPreview"
			else "CornEditorOverview"
		if
			folder
			and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and folder:GetAttribute(attribute) == true
		then
			for _, part in folder:GetDescendants() do
				if
					part:IsA("BasePart")
					and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
					and part:GetAttribute(attribute) == true
				then
					self:_hide(part)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self._nodes, self._ready = nil, true
	near:SetAttribute("AuthoredPlants", #self._records)
	self._reconcileElapsed = math.huge
end

function Controller:_indexBatch()
	if self._preparing or not self._templates or not self._nodes then
		return
	end
	local began, count = self._clock(), 0
	while
		self._index <= #self._nodes
		and count < INDEX_BUDGET
		and self._clock() - began < INDEX_TIME
	do
		local item = self._nodes[self._index]
		self._index += 1
		count += 1
		assert(item:IsDescendantOf(self._source), "Authoring inventory changed during snapshot")
		if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
			self:_record(item)
		else
			assert(
				item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("Folder"),
				"Foreign authoring contents were preserved"
			)
		end
	end
	if self._index > #self._nodes then
		self:_publishSnapshot()
	end
end

function Controller:_dropChunk(chunk)
	for _, record in chunk.Records do
		if self._nearByRecord[record] then
			self._nearByRecord[record] = nil
			self._nearCount -= 1
			if record.FarPart and record.FarPart.Parent == self._farFolder then
				record.FarPart.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
			end
		end
	end
	if ownedTree(chunk.Folder) then
		chunk.Folder:Destroy()
	else
		error("Foreign near chunk content was preserved")
	end
	self._chunks[chunk.Key] = nil
end

function Controller:_reconcile()
	local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local point = self._fieldFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.CFrame.Position)
	local desired = {}
	for x = math.floor((point.X - RETAIN) / self._width), math.floor((point.X + RETAIN) / self._width) do
		for z = math.floor((point.Z - RETAIN) / self._width), math.floor((point.Z + RETAIN) / self._width) do
			local key = x .. ":" .. z
			local bucket = self._buckets[key]
			local distance = ((x + 0.5) * self._width - point.X) ^ 2
				+ ((z + 0.5) * self._width - point.Z) ^ 2
			if bucket and distance <= (if self._chunks[key] then RETAIN else RADIUS) ^ 2 then
				table.insert(desired, { Bucket = bucket, Distance = distance })
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance
			then a.Bucket.Key < b.Bucket.Key
			else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local wanted = {}
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > 200 then
			break
		end
		local bucket = candidate.Bucket
		wanted[bucket.Key] = true
		local chunk = self._chunks[bucket.Key]
		local denseRadius = if chunk and chunk.Stride == 1
			then DENSE_RADIUS + 12
			elseif chunk then DENSE_RADIUS - 12
			else DENSE_RADIUS
		local stride = if candidate.Distance <= denseRadius ^ 2 then 1 else 2
		if chunk and chunk.Stride ~= stride then
			self:_dropChunk(chunk)
			chunk = nil
		end
		if not chunk then
			local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
			folder.Name = "Chunk_" .. bucket.Key
			stamp(folder)
			folder.Parent = self._nearFolder
			chunk = {
				Key = bucket.Key,
				Folder = folder,
				Records = bucket.Records,
				Index = 1,
				Stride = stride,
				Lod = if index <= 8 then "Near" else "Mid",
			}
			self._chunks[bucket.Key] = chunk
		end
		chunk.Distance = candidate.Distance
	end
	local removals = {}
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			table.insert(removals, chunk)
		end
	end
	for _, chunk in removals do
		self:_dropChunk(chunk)
	end
	self._queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		if chunk.Index <= #chunk.Records then
			table.insert(self._queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table.sort(self._queue, function(a, b)
		return a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
end

function Controller:_clone(record, lod)
	local plant =
		assert(self._templates[lod][record.Variety]:Clone(), "Authored corn template clone failed")
	plant.Size, plant.CFrame = record.Size, record.Frame
	plant.Transparency, plant.CastShadow = record.Transparency, true
	plant:SetAttribute("BManualSourceTransparency", nil)
	stamp(plant)
	return plant
end

function Controller:_buildBatch()
	if not self._ready then
		return
	end
	local began, created, examined = self._clock(), 0, 0
	while created < CLONE_BUDGET and examined < 100 and self._clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET do
		examined += 1
		local chunk = self._queue[1]
		if chunk and self._nearCount < NEAR_CAP then
			local record = chunk.Records[chunk.Index]
			chunk.Index += 1
			if chunk.Index > #chunk.Records then
				table.remove(self._queue, 1)
			end
			if record.Column % chunk.Stride ~= 0 or record.Row % chunk.Stride ~= 0 then
				continue
			end
			local plant = self:_clone(record, chunk.Lod)
			plant.Name, plant.Parent = "Corn", chunk.Folder
			self._nearByRecord[record] = plant
			self._nearCount += 1
			if record.FarPart then
				record.FarPart.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			end
		elseif self._farIndex <= #self._far then
			local record = self._far[self._farIndex]
			self._farIndex += 1
			local plant = self:_clone(record, "Far")
			plant.Name = "Far_" .. record.Index .. "_0"
			plant:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
			plant:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
			plant:SetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned", nil)
			plant.LocalTransparencyModifier = if self._nearByRecord[record] then 1 else 0
			plant.Parent, record.FarPart = self._farFolder, plant
		else
			break
		end
		created += 1
	end
	self._nearFolder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._nearCount)
	self._farFolder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._farIndex - 1)
	self._farFolder:SetAttribute("LastFrameClones", created)
	self._farFolder:SetAttribute("LastFrameSeconds", self._clock() - began)
	if self._farIndex > #self._far then
		self._farFolder:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
	end
end

function Controller:_step(delta)
	self._poll += delta
	if self._poll >= 0.5 then
		self._poll = 0
		local map, source, field = target()
		if map ~= self._map or source ~= self._source or field ~= self._field then
			if source and source ~= self._failedSource then
				self:_begin(map, source, field)
			else
				self:_clear()
			end
		end
	end
	if not self._map then
		return
	end
	local map, source, field = target()
	assert(
		map == self._map
			and source == self._source
			and field == self._field
			and field.CFrame == self._fieldFrame
			and field.Size == self._fieldSize,
		"Authoring ownership or field changed; saved placements restored"
	)
	self._quiet += delta
	self._settleAge += delta
	if (self._waiting or self._dirty) and (self._quiet >= 0.75 or self._settleAge >= 10) then
		if self._waiting then
			self:_startSnapshot()
		else
			self:_begin(map, source, field)
			self._quiet = 0.75
		end
	end
	if self._ready then
		assert(
			self._nearFolder.Parent == map
				and self._farFolder.Parent == map
				and self._nearFolder:GetAttribute("BManualCornRuntimeOwner") == OWNER
				and self._farFolder:GetAttribute("BManualCornRuntimeOwner") == OWNER,
			"Runtime ownership changed; author placements restored"
		)
	end
	self:_indexBatch()
	if self._ready then
		self._reconcileElapsed += delta
		if self._reconcileElapsed >= 0.3 then
			self._reconcileElapsed = 0
			self:_reconcile()
		end
		self:_buildBatch()
	end
end

function Controller:Init(context)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and (
			context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
			or context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "team_local"
		)
	self._epoch, self._hidden = 0, {}
	self._clock, self._poll, self._reconcileElapsed = os.clock, math.huge, math.huge
	self:_clear()
end

function Controller:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		local ok, problem = pcall(self._step, self, delta)
		if not ok then
			self._failedSource = self._source
			self:_clear()
			self:_warn("Authored scene preserved: " .. tostring(problem))
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clear()
end

return Controller

--!strict

local GreenBedLayout = require(script.Parent.GreenBedLayout)

	Height = 8,
	Spacing = 3,
	Seed = 817,
	ChunkCells = 12,
	RenderRadius = 150,
	ElevatedRadius = 200,
	DenseRadius = 60,
	MediumRadius = 130,

export type Plant = Model | BasePart
export type Box = { Frame: CFrame, HalfSize: Vector2 }
export type Circle = { Center: Vector3, Radius: number }
export type TrailEdge = {
	CenterX: number,
	CenterZ: number,
	HalfWidth: number,
	HalfLength: number,
	AlongX: boolean,
	Key: string,
}

	Circles: { Circle },
	Signature: string,
	TrailEdges: { TrailEdge }?,
	TrailEdgeMaxShift: number?,
	GreenBeds: boolean?,
	AuthoredCorn: any?,
}

local SLOT_RADIUS = 6
local BOX_PADDING = 1.5
-- The B grid keeps regular rows: 30% fewer plants per unit area, rather than
-- removing hashed individual cells and leaving irregular holes in each row.
local DETAILED_SPACING_SCALE = 1 / math.sqrt(2.6 * 0.7)
local TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET = 0.05
local GREEN_TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET = 0.15
local authoredCache = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function greenField(field: BasePart): boolean
	local map = field.Parent
	return field.Name == "FieldZone"
		and field.Size == Vector3.new(630, 10, 630)
		and map ~= nil
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
end

local function finite(value: number): boolean
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

function CornLayout.Bounds(plant: Plant): (CFrame, Vector3)
	if plant:IsA("Model") then
		return plant:GetBoundingBox()
	end
	return plant.CFrame, plant.Size
end

function CornLayout.PrepareTemplate(source: Instance, height: number?): (Plant?, string?)
	if not source:IsA("Model") and not source:IsA("BasePart") then
		return nil, "Corn source must be a Model or BasePart"
	end
	local targetHeight = height or CornLayout.Height
	if not finite(targetHeight) or targetHeight <= 0 then
		return nil, "Corn height must be positive and finite"
	end
	local items = source:GetDescendants()
	table.insert(items, source)
	local partCount = 0
	for _, item in items do
		if item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			return nil, "Corn source contains code"
		end
		if
			item:IsA("Sound")
			or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
			or item:IsA("Beam")
			or item:IsA("Trail")
			or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			or item:IsA("ClickDetector")
			or item:IsA("RemoteEvent")
			or item:IsA("RemoteFunction")
		then
			return nil, "Corn source must contain only static art"
		end
		if not item.Archivable then
			return nil, "Corn source has non-Archivable contents"
		end
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			partCount += 1
		end
	end
	if partCount == 0 then
		return nil, "Corn source has no BaseParts"
	end

	local prepared = source:Clone() :: Plant?
	if not prepared then
		return nil, "Corn source could not be cloned"
	end
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		local _, size = CornLayout.Bounds(prepared :: Plant)
		if not finite(size.Y) or size.Y <= 0 then
			error("Corn source has no usable height")
		end
		local ratio = targetHeight / size.Y
		if prepared:IsA("Model") then
			prepared:ScaleTo(prepared:GetScale() * ratio)
		else
			prepared.Size *= ratio
			for _, item in prepared:GetChildren() do
				if item:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
					item.Scale *= ratio
				end
			end
		end
		-- The imported plant has one mesh plus import poses/animation metadata.
		-- Keep only that normalized mesh on decorative copies; the source is untouched.
		if prepared:IsA("Model") and partCount == 1 then
			local mesh = prepared:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true)
			if mesh and mesh:IsA("MeshPart") then
				mesh.Parent = nil
				prepared:Destroy()
				prepared = mesh
			end
		end
		for _, item in prepared:GetDescendants() do
			if
				item:IsA("AnimationController")
				or (item:IsA("Folder") and item.Name == "InitialPoses")
			then
				item:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local clones = prepared:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(clones, prepared)
		for _, item in clones do
			-- Art tags must not become gameplay bindings on every decorative clone.
			for _, tag in item:GetTags() do
				item:RemoveTag(tag)
			end
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanTouch = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CastShadow = false
				if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.DoubleSided = true
					if item.MeshId == "rbxassetid://104111861186519" then
						item.TextureID = "rbxassetid://137803536172445"
						item.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
						item:SetAttribute("CornGreenOriginal", true)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		prepared:PivotTo(CornLayout.PivotForPlant(prepared, Vector3.zero, 0))
	end)
	if not ok then
		prepared:Destroy()
		return nil, tostring(problem)
	end
	return prepared, nil
end

function CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant: Plant, groundPosition: Vector3, yaw: number): CFrame
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(plant)
	local boundsFromPivot = plant:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds)
	return CFrame.new(groundPosition + Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0))
		* CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
		* boundsFromPivot:Inverse()
end

function CornLayout.SpacingFor(field: BasePart): number
	local map = field.Parent
	if
		field.Name == "FieldZone"
		and map
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	then
		return CornLayout.Spacing * DETAILED_SPACING_SCALE
	end
	return CornLayout.Spacing
end

function CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field: BasePart): (number, number, number, number)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	return math.ceil(-half.X / spacing),
		math.floor(half.X / spacing),
		math.ceil(-half.Z / spacing),
		math.floor(half.Z / spacing)
end

function CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field: BasePart, column: number, row: number): Vector3
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	if greenField(field) then
		return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(column * spacing, -half.Y, row * spacing))
	end
	local hashX = (column * 92837111 + row * 689287499 + CornLayout.Seed) % 104729
	local hashZ = (column * 19349663 + row * 83492791 + CornLayout.Seed) % 104729
	local stagger = if row % 2 == 0 then -spacing * 0.15 else spacing * 0.15
	local x = column * spacing + stagger + (hashX / 104729 - 0.5) * spacing * 0.12
	local z = row * spacing + (hashZ / 104729 - 0.5) * spacing * 0.12
	return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
		Vector3.new(math.clamp(x, -half.X, half.X), -half.Y, math.clamp(z, -half.Z, half.Z))
	)
end

local function hash(column: number, row: number, salt: number): number
	return ((column * 73856093 + row * 19349663 + CornLayout.Seed * salt) % 104729) / 104729
end

function CornLayout.CellPosition(field: BasePart, column: number, row: number): Vector3
	if greenField(field) then
		return GreenBedLayout.Position(CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field, column, row))
	end
	local point = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field, column, row))
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
		Vector3.new(
			math.clamp(point.X + (hash(column, row, 17) * 2 - 1) * spacing * 0.1, -half.X, half.X),
			point.Y,
			math.clamp(point.Z + (hash(column, row, 31) * 2 - 1) * spacing * 0.1, -half.Z, half.Z)
		)
	)
end

function CornLayout.CellYaw(column: number, row: number): number
	return hash(column, row, 61) * math.pi * 2
end

function CornLayout.HeightFactor(column: number, row: number): number
	return 0.85 + hash(column, row, 97) * 0.3
end

function CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant: Plant, column: number, row: number)
	if plant:GetAttribute("CornGreenOriginal") == true then
		-- All four green geometry templates start at height eight. Scale only Y;
		-- DetailedPivot subsequently uses their real root anchor and this Size.
		local factor = CornLayout.HeightFactor(column, row)
		assert(plant:IsA("BasePart"), "B green height variation requires a single static part")
		plant.Size = Vector3.new(plant.Size.X, plant.Size.Y * factor, plant.Size.Z)
		return
	end
	-- Preserve the legacy fallback path; A has its own canonical module.
	local sign = if hash(column, row, 79) < 0.5 then -1 else 1
	local factor = 1 + sign * (0.1 + hash(column, row, 97) * 0.05)
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		plant.Size = Vector3.new(plant.Size.X, plant.Size.Y * factor, plant.Size.Z)
	else
		plant:ScaleTo(plant:GetScale() * factor)
	end
end

local function footprint(frame: CFrame, size: Vector3, padding: number): Box
	local look = frame.LookVector
	local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
	local flat = CFrame.new(frame.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	local half = size / 2
	local right = flat.RightVector
	local forward = flat.LookVector
	local width = math.abs(right:Dot(frame.RightVector)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(right:Dot(frame.UpVector)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(right:Dot(frame.LookVector)) * half.Z
	local depth = math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.RightVector)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.UpVector)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.LookVector)) * half.Z
	return { Frame = flat, HalfSize = Vector2.new(width + padding, depth + padding) }
end

local function authorDescendants(map: Model): { Instance }
	local result: { Instance } = {}
	local stack = map:GetChildren()
	while #stack > 0 do
		local item = table.remove(stack)
		local owned = item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		local decoration = owned
			and (
				(item.Name == "EditorPreview" and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true)
				or (item.Name == "EditorFieldOverview" and item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true)
				or (item.Name == "CornClientPlants" and item:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") == true)
				or (item.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" and item:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientBackdropOwned"
				) == true)
				or item.Name == "CornRoundRuntime"
				or (item.Name == "CornAuthoring" and item:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1)
				or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner") == "corn_B_green_beds_v1"
			)
		if decoration then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(result, item)
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			table.insert(stack, child)
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function refreshAuthored(state)
	if not state.Dirty then
		return
	end
	local buckets = {}
	local count = 0
	for _, part in state.Source:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
			local opacity = part:GetAttribute("BManualSourceTransparency")
			if type(opacity) ~= "number" then
				opacity = part.Transparency
			end
			local offset = part:GetAttribute("HarvestRootOffset")
			local templateSize = part:GetAttribute("CornGreenTemplateSize")
			if
				type(opacity) == "number"
				and finite(opacity)
				and opacity < 1
				and typeof(offset) == "Vector3"
				and typeof(templateSize) == "Vector3"
				and templateSize.X > 0
				and templateSize.Y > 0
				and templateSize.Z > 0
			then
				local size = part.Size
				local root = part.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
					-Vector3.new(
						offset.X * size.X / templateSize.X,
						offset.Y * size.Y / templateSize.Y,
						offset.Z * size.Z / templateSize.Z
					)
				)
				if finite(root.X) and finite(root.Z) then
					local key = math.floor(root.X / state.Width)
						.. ":"
						.. math.floor(root.Z / state.Width)
					if not buckets[key] then
						buckets[key] = {}
					end
					table.insert(buckets[key], root)
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end
	end
	state.Buckets, state.Count, state.Dirty = buckets, count, false
end

function CornLayout.AuthoringSource(map: Instance?): Folder?
	if
		not (
			map
			and map:IsA("Model")
			and map.Name == "CornMap"
			and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
			and map:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
		)
	then
		return nil
	end
	local function ownedSource(folder)
		return folder
			and folder:IsA("Folder")
			and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and folder:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
	end
	local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local root = storage:FindFirstChild("BManualEditorSources")
	if ownedSource(root) then
		local source = root:FindFirstChild("CornAuthoring")
		if ownedSource(source) then
			return source
		end
	end
	local source = map:FindFirstChild("CornAuthoring")
	return if ownedSource(source) then source else nil
end

local function authoredExclusions(map, field)
	local source = CornLayout.AuthoringSource(map)
	if
		not (
			greenField(field)
			and map:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
			and source
			and source:IsA("Folder")
			and source:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and source:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
		)
	then
		return nil
	end
	local state = authoredCache[map]
	if
		not state
		or state.Source ~= source
		or state.Frame ~= field.CFrame
		or state.Size ~= field.Size
	then
		if state then
			for _, connection in state.Connections do
				connection:Disconnect()
			end
		end
		local radius = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field) * 0.72
		state = {
			Map = map,
			Source = source,
			Frame = field.CFrame,
			Size = field.Size,
			Radius = radius,
			Width = radius * 2 + 0.01,
			Buckets = {},
			Dirty = true,
			Connections = {},
		}
		local function invalidate()
			state.Dirty = true
		end
		state.Connections = {
			source.DescendantAdded:Connect(invalidate),
			source.DescendantRemoving:Connect(invalidate),
		}
		authoredCache[map] = state
	end
	refreshAuthored(state)
	return {
		Boxes = {},
		Circles = {},
		TrailEdges = {},
		AuthoredCorn = state,
		Signature = "B-manual-authoring-v1/" .. tostring(field.CFrame) .. "/" .. tostring(
			field.Size
		),
	}
end

function CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map: Model, field: BasePart): Exclusions
	local authored = authoredExclusions(map, field)
	if authored then
		return authored
	end
	local boxes: { Box } = {}
	local circles: { Circle } = {}
	local trailEdges: { TrailEdge } = {}
	local signatures: { string } = { tostring(field.CFrame) .. "/" .. tostring(field.Size) }
	local included: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
	local detailed = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field) ~= CornLayout.Spacing
	local noCorn = map:FindFirstChild("NoCornZones")
	local maze = if noCorn then noCorn:FindFirstChild("Maze02Masks") else nil
	local function ownedTrail(part: BasePart): boolean
		local index = tonumber(part.Name:match("^trail_(%d%d%d)$"))
		return detailed
			and map == field.Parent
			and maze ~= nil
			and maze:IsA("Folder")
			and maze:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and maze:GetAttribute("CornMazeOwner") == "corn_maze02_v1"
			and part.Parent == maze
			and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and part:GetAttribute("CornMazeOwner") == "corn_maze02_v1"
			and index ~= nil
			and index >= 1
			and index <= 100
			and math.abs(part.Size.Y - 0.08) < 0.001
			and math.min(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) == 4
			and math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) >= 30
			and part.CFrame.Rotation == CFrame.identity
	end
	local function addBox(part: BasePart, padding: number)
		if included[part] then
			return
		end
		included[part] = true
		local trail = ownedTrail(part)
		if trail then
			-- The visible four-stud path is the root clearance. Fixed props keep
			-- their existing safety margin; leaves may reach over the path edge.
			padding = 0
		end
		local box = footprint(part.CFrame, part.Size, padding)
		table.insert(boxes, box)
		if trail then
			local center = part.CFrame.Position
			table.insert(trailEdges, {
				CenterX = center.X,
				CenterZ = center.Z,
				HalfWidth = math.min(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) / 2,
				HalfLength = math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) / 2,
				AlongX = part.Size.X > part.Size.Z,
				Key = part.Name,
			})
		end
		table.insert(
			signatures,
			part:GetFullName()
				.. "/box/"
				.. tostring(part.CFrame)
				.. "/"
				.. tostring(part.Size)
				.. "/"
				.. padding
		)
	end
	for _, folderName in { "NoCornZones", "Props" } do
		local folder = map:FindFirstChild(folderName)
		if folder then
			for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
				if item:IsA("BasePart") then
					addBox(item, BOX_PADDING)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, item in authorDescendants(map) do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			if item:HasTag("corn_no_corn_zone") then
				addBox(item, BOX_PADDING)
			end
			if item:HasTag("corn_key_slot") then
				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = SLOT_RADIUS })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/slot/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			elseif item:HasTag("corn_spawn") then
				addBox(item, 4)
				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = 10 })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/spawn/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			end
		end
	end
	local gate = map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	if gate then
		local door = gate:FindFirstChild("Door", true)
		if door and door:IsA("BasePart") then
			addBox(door, 6)
		end
	end
	table.sort(signatures)
	table.sort(trailEdges, function(a, b)
		return a.Key < b.Key
	end)
	local signature = table.concat(signatures, "|")
	local green = greenField(field)
	if green then
		local matches = signature == GreenBedLayout.Signature
		if not matches and game:GetService("RunService"):IsClient() then
			matches = GreenBedLayout.MatchesExclusions({ Boxes = boxes, Circles = circles }, field)
		end
		assert(matches, "B clearances changed; regenerate the guarded green-bed plan")
		-- A stable accepted signature keeps normal network rounding from causing
		-- repeated renderer rebuilds. Exact Edit/server checks remain above.
		signature = GreenBedLayout.Signature
			.. "|green-beds-v2-density70/"
			.. GreenBedLayout.InputSHA256
	end
	return {
		Boxes = boxes,
		Circles = circles,
		Signature = signature,
		TrailEdges = trailEdges,
		TrailEdgeMaxShift = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field),
		GreenBeds = green,
	}
end

function CornLayout.IsExcluded(position: Vector3, exclusions: Exclusions): boolean
	local authored = exclusions.AuthoredCorn
	if authored then
		if
			CornLayout.AuthoringSource(authored.Map) ~= authored.Source
			or authored.Source:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") ~= 1
			or authored.Source:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= "children_of_corn"
		then
			return true
		end
		refreshAuthored(authored)
		local point = authored.Frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if math.abs(point.X) > authored.Size.X / 2 or math.abs(point.Z) > authored.Size.Z / 2 then
			return true
		end
		local radius, width = authored.Radius, authored.Width
		-- Width exceeds the diameter: each query visits at most four buckets.
		for x = math.floor((position.X - radius) / width), math.floor((position.X + radius) / width) do
			for z = math.floor((position.Z - radius) / width), math.floor((position.Z + radius) / width) do
				for _, root in authored.Buckets[x .. ":" .. z] or {} do
					local dx, dz = position.X - root.X, position.Z - root.Z
					if dx * dx + dz * dz <= radius * radius then
						return false
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return true
	end
	if exclusions.GreenBeds and not GreenBedLayout.Contains(position) then
		return true
	end
	for _, circle in exclusions.Circles do
		local delta = position - circle.Center
		if delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z <= circle.Radius * circle.Radius then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, box in exclusions.Boxes do
		local localPosition = box.Frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if
			math.abs(localPosition.X) <= box.HalfSize.X
			and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= box.HalfSize.Y
		then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function CornLayout.TrailEdgePosition(position: Vector3, exclusions: Exclusions): Vector3
	local edges = exclusions.TrailEdges
	local reach = exclusions.TrailEdgeMaxShift
	if not edges or #edges == 0 or not reach then
		return position
	end
	local bestGap = math.huge
	local x, z = position.X, position.Z
	local candidateX, candidateZ = x, z
	local found = false
	local outset = if exclusions.GreenBeds then GREEN_TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET else TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET
	for _, edge in edges do
		local dx, dz = x - edge.CenterX, z - edge.CenterZ
		local across = if edge.AlongX then dz else dx
		local along = if edge.AlongX then dx else dz
		local gap = math.abs(across) - edge.HalfWidth
		if
			gap >= (if exclusions.GreenBeds then outset else 0)
			and gap <= reach
			and gap < bestGap
			and math.abs(along) <= edge.HalfLength - 1
		then
			bestGap = gap
			local target = (if across < 0 then -1 else 1) * (edge.HalfWidth + outset)
			candidateX = if edge.AlongX then x else edge.CenterX + target
			candidateZ = if edge.AlongX then edge.CenterZ + target else z
			found = true
		end
	end
	-- Reuse existing cells, variants and render budgets. Both the original and
	-- projected root must pass every clearance, including crossing paths.
	local candidate = if found then Vector3.new(candidateX, position.Y, candidateZ) else nil
	if candidate and exclusions.GreenBeds then
		local height = GreenBedLayout.GetHeight(candidate)
		if not height then
			-- Rounded FBX skirts do not fill their bounding rectangles. Retain
			-- the closest real bed surface along this bounded, path-safe segment;
			-- never invent soil heights or add an extra plant at the trail edge.
			local valid, invalid = 0, 1
			local base = position
			local delta = candidate - base
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				local amount = (valid + invalid) / 2
				local sample = base + delta * amount
				local sampledHeight = GreenBedLayout.GetHeight(sample)
				if sampledHeight then
					valid, height = amount, sampledHeight
				else
					invalid = amount
				end
			end
			if valid == 0 then
				return position
			end
			candidate = base + delta * valid
		end
		assert(height, "Projected B corn root requires a real bed surface")
		candidate = Vector3.new(candidate.X, height, candidate.Z)
	end
	if
		candidate
		and not CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions)
		and not CornLayout.IsExcluded(candidate, exclusions)
	then
		return candidate
	end
	return position
end

return CornLayout

--!strict
-- Additive art only. Authored transforms, collision, textures and Terrain stay intact.
local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local world = game:GetService("Workspace")

	storage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("HarvestArtGeometry")

local Pose =
	require(storage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("MonsterPose"))
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local OWNER = "harvest_warden_v1"
local HOUSES = { "HouseWest", "HouseEast", "HouseNorthWest" }
local SOURCE_NAMES = { "SM_Bld_Barn_03", "SM_Bld_Barn_03_Shutter_01", "SM_Bld_Barn_03_Shutter_02" }
local HarvestWorld = {}

local function visibleBranch(branch: any, variant: string): boolean
	return branch == "Common" or branch == variant
end

local function owned(item: Instance)
	return item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and item:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner") == OWNER
end

local function stamp(item: Instance)
	item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	item:SetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner", OWNER)
end

local function seal(root: Instance)
	for _, item in { root, table.unpack(root:GetDescendants()) } do
		item:SetAttribute("HarvestExpectedChildren", #item:GetChildren())
		item:SetAttribute("HarvestExpectedName", item.Name)
	end
end

local function equal(a: any, b: any): boolean
	if typeof(a) == "CFrame" and typeof(b) == "CFrame" then
		local left, right = { a:GetComponents() }, { b:GetComponents() }
		for index, value in left do
			if math.abs(value - right[index]) > 0.0001 then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	elseif typeof(a) == "Vector3" and typeof(b) == "Vector3" then
		return (a - b).Magnitude < 0.0001
	end
	return a == b
end

local function mapBinding(): (Model, Folder, BasePart, BasePart)
	local map = world:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	assert(
		map
			and map:IsA("Model")
			and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and not world:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
			and not world:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models"),
		"Harvest art requires the Children_of_corn map"
	)
	local props, ground, field =
		map:FindFirstChild("Props"), map:FindFirstChild("Ground"), map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
	assert(
		props
			and props:IsA("Folder")
			and ground
			and ground:IsA("BasePart")
			and field
			and field:IsA("BasePart"),
		"Harvest map bindings missing"
	)
	assert(
		ground.Size == Vector3.new(630, 2, 630) and field.Size == Vector3.new(630, 10, 630),
		"Harvest art requires the accepted 630 field"
	)
	assert(
		ground.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) > 0.9999,
		"Harvest ground must remain horizontal"

end

local function barnSources(props: Folder): { any }
	local result = {}
	for _, houseName in HOUSES do
		local house = props:FindFirstChild(houseName)

				and house:GetAttribute("AssetKey") == "SM_Bld_Barn_03",

		)

			assert(

					and part:IsA("MeshPart")
					and part:GetAttribute("CornFarmMeshOwned") == true
					and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
					and part:GetAttribute("AssetKey") == "SM_Bld_Barn_03"

local function sourceFor(props: Folder, item: Instance): MeshPart

	assert(
		source
			and source:IsA("MeshPart")
			and source:GetAttribute("CornFarmMeshOwned") == true
			and source:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
			and equal(source.CFrame, item:GetAttribute("HarvestSourceFrame"))
			and equal(source.Size, item:GetAttribute("HarvestSourceSize")),
		"Harvest original barn binding changed; author work preserved"
	)
	return source
end

local function freezePart(part: BasePart, branch: string)
	stamp(part)
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part:SetAttribute("HarvestBranch", branch)
	part:SetAttribute("HarvestPlacedFrame", part.CFrame)
	part:SetAttribute("HarvestPlacedSize", part.Size)
	part:SetAttribute("HarvestVisibleTransparency", part.Transparency)
	part:SetAttribute("HarvestTexture", if part:IsA("MeshPart") then part.TextureID else "")
	part:SetAttribute("HarvestColor", part.Color)
	part:SetAttribute("HarvestMaterial", part.Material.Name)
	part:SetAttribute("HarvestCastShadow", part.CastShadow)
end

local function validateDecor(root: Instance, props: Folder, variant: string)
	assert(
		root:IsA("Folder") and owned(root) and root:GetAttribute("HarvestWorldVersion") == 1,
		"Foreign HarvestDecor preserved"
	)
	assert(
		root:GetAttribute("HarvestAppliedVariant") == variant,
		"Harvest variant metadata differs"
	)
	assert(
		#root:GetChildren() == root:GetAttribute("HarvestExpectedChildren")
			and root.Name == root:GetAttribute("HarvestExpectedName"),
		"Harvest root topology edit preserved"
	)
	for _, item in root:GetDescendants() do
		assert(owned(item), "Foreign child inside HarvestDecor preserved: " .. item:GetFullName())
		assert(
			#item:GetChildren() == item:GetAttribute("HarvestExpectedChildren")
				and item.Name == item:GetAttribute("HarvestExpectedName"),
			"Harvest decor topology edit preserved"
		)
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			local visible = item:GetAttribute("HarvestVisibleTransparency")
			local expected = if visibleBranch(item:GetAttribute("HarvestBranch"), variant)
				then visible
				else 1
			assert(
				equal(item.CFrame, item:GetAttribute("HarvestPlacedFrame"))
					and equal(item.Size, item:GetAttribute("HarvestPlacedSize"))
					and item.Transparency == expected
					and item.Anchored
					and not item.CanCollide
					and not item.CanTouch
					and not item.CanQuery
					and item.Color == item:GetAttribute("HarvestColor")
					and item.Material.Name == item:GetAttribute("HarvestMaterial")
					and item.CastShadow == item:GetAttribute("HarvestCastShadow"),
				"Harvest authored decor edit preserved: " .. item:GetFullName()
			)
			if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
				assert(
					type(item:GetAttribute("HarvestMeshKey")) == "string"
						and item.TextureID == item:GetAttribute("HarvestTexture"),
					"Harvest mesh/texture edit preserved"
				)
			end
			if item:GetAttribute("HarvestSourceName") then
				local source = sourceFor(props, item)
				assert(
					source.Transparency
						== (
							if variant == "B"
								then 1
								else item:GetAttribute("HarvestSourceTransparency")
						),
					"Harvest barn appearance edit preserved"
				)
			end
		elseif item:IsA("Texture") then
			local expected = if visibleBranch(item:GetAttribute("HarvestBranch"), variant)
				then item:GetAttribute("HarvestVisibleTransparency")
				else 1
			assert(
				item.Texture == item:GetAttribute("HarvestTexture")
					and item.Transparency == expected
					and item.Face == Enum.NormalId.Top
					and item.StudsPerTileU == item:GetAttribute("HarvestTileSize")
					and item.StudsPerTileV == item:GetAttribute("HarvestTileSize"),
				"Harvest ground texture edit preserved"
			)
		else
			assert(
				item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("Folder"),
				"Foreign HarvestDecor instance preserved"
			)
		end
	end
end

local function cloneAsset(
	assetKey: string,
	name: string,
	frame: CFrame,
	parent: Instance,
	branch: string,
	scale: number?
): Model
	local template = Geometry.Template(assetKey)
	assert(template and template:IsA("Model"), "Harvest model template required: " .. assetKey)
	local model = template:Clone()
	model.Name = name
	stamp(model)
	model:SetAttribute("HarvestAssetKey", assetKey)
	-- Template parts carry baked global-to-asset centers; no importer pivot assumption.
	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		assert(part:IsA("MeshPart"), "Harvest template contains unexpected hierarchy")
		part.CFrame = frame * CFrame.new(part.CFrame.Position * (scale or 1)) * part.CFrame.Rotation
		part.Size *= scale or 1
		freezePart(part, branch)
	end
	model.Parent = parent
	return model
end

local function homeBinding(props: Folder): (Model, { BasePart })
	local home = props:FindFirstChild("ScarecrowMarker")
	assert(
		home and home:IsA("Model") and home:HasTag("corn_monster_home"),
		"Harvest monster home binding missing"
	)
	local parts = {}
	for _, name in { "Head", "Arms", "Body" } do
		local part = home:FindFirstChild(name)
		assert(part and part.ClassName == "Part", "Unknown original home marker part: " .. name)
		table.insert(parts, part :: BasePart)
	end
	return home, parts
end

local function prepareHome(props: Folder, ground: BasePart): (Folder, boolean, { BasePart })
	local home, originals = homeBinding(props)
	local old = home:FindFirstChild("HarvestWardenHome")
	if old then
		assert(old:IsA("Folder") and #old:GetChildren() == 2, "Foreign HarvestWardenHome preserved")
		local variant = old:GetAttribute("HarvestAppliedVariant")
		validateDecor(old, props, variant)
		assert(
			old:FindFirstChild("Classic") and old:FindFirstChild("Detailed"),
			"Incomplete home visual variants"
		)
		for _, part in originals do
			assert(
				part.Transparency == 1
					and equal(part.CFrame, old:GetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceFrame"))
					and equal(part.Size, old:GetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceSize")),
				"Original home marker edit preserved"
			)
		end
		return old :: Folder, false, originals
	end
	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "HarvestWardenHome"
	stamp(root)
	root:SetAttribute("HarvestWorldVersion", 1)
	local head = originals[1]
	local frame = CFrame.new(
		head.CFrame.Position.X,
		ground.CFrame.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2,
		head.CFrame.Position.Z
	) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi, 0)
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		for _, part in originals do
			assert(part.Transparency == 0, "Original home marker appearance differs")
			root:SetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceFrame", part.CFrame)
			root:SetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceSize", part.Size)
			root:SetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceTransparency", part.Transparency)
		end
		cloneAsset("WardenClassic", "Classic", frame, root, "A", Pose.WardenScale)
		cloneAsset("WardenDetailed", "Detailed", frame, root, "B", Pose.WardenScale)
		seal(root)
	end)
	if not ok then
		root:Destroy()
		error("Harvest home preparation failed: " .. tostring(problem))
	end
	return root, true, originals
end

local function safePlacement(map: Model, frame: CFrame, radius: number)
	for _, folderName in { "KeySlots", "CornerSpawns" } do
		local folder = assert(map:FindFirstChild(folderName), "Harvest clearance folder missing")
		for _, part in folder:GetChildren() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local delta = part.CFrame.Position - frame.Position
				assert(
					Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > radius + 10,
					"Harvest decor would cover a slot or start"
				)
			end
		end
	end
	local gate = assert(map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate"), "Harvest gate missing")
	local anchor = gate:FindFirstChild("InteractionAnchor")
	assert(anchor and anchor:IsA("BasePart"), "Harvest gate interaction anchor missing")
	local delta = anchor.CFrame.Position - frame.Position
	assert(
		Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude > radius + 18,
		"Harvest decor would cover gate/exit"
	)
end

local function groundTexture(assetKey: string): string
	local template = Geometry.Template(assetKey)
	local part = if template:IsA("MeshPart")
		then template
		else template:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("MeshPart", true)
	assert(part and part.TextureID ~= "", "Harvest ground texture not uploaded")
	return part.TextureID

local function layoutBinding(root: Instance, props: Folder, ground: BasePart)
	local roadFolder = props:FindFirstChild("VillageRoad")
	local road = roadFolder and roadFolder:FindFirstChild("RoadSurface")
	assert(

	assert(

			and equal(road.CFrame, root:GetAttribute("HarvestRoadFrame"))

	)

local function plane(
	parent: Folder,
	name: string,
	frame: CFrame,
	size: Vector3,
	textureId: string,
	tile: number
)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.CFrame = frame
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(104, 86, 66)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Ground
	part.CastShadow = false
	freezePart(part, "B")
	local texture = Instance.new("Texture")
	texture.Name = "HarvestSurface"
	stamp(texture)
	texture.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
	texture.Texture = textureId
	texture.StudsPerTileU = tile
	texture.StudsPerTileV = tile
	texture:SetAttribute("HarvestTexture", textureId)
	texture:SetAttribute("HarvestTileSize", tile)
	texture:SetAttribute("HarvestBranch", "B")
	texture:SetAttribute("HarvestVisibleTransparency", texture.Transparency)
	texture.Parent = part
	part.Parent = parent
end

local function build(map: Model, props: Folder, ground: BasePart, sources: { any }): Folder
	local root = Instance.new("Folder")
	root.Name = "HarvestDecor"
	stamp(root)
	root:SetAttribute("HarvestWorldVersion", 1)
	root:SetAttribute("HarvestGroundFrame", ground.CFrame)
	root:SetAttribute("HarvestGroundSize", ground.Size)
	local common, detailed = Instance.new("Folder"), Instance.new("Folder")
	common.Name, detailed.Name = "Common", "VariantB"
	stamp(common)
	stamp(detailed)
	common.Parent, detailed.Parent = root, root
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		local floorY = ground.CFrame.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
		local count = 0
		local function decor(key: string, name: string, frame: CFrame, radius: number)
			safePlacement(map, frame, radius)
			cloneAsset(key, name, frame, common, "Common")
			count += 1
		end
		for houseIndex, houseName in HOUSES do
			local shell =
				assert(props:FindFirstChild(houseName)):FindFirstChild("SM_Bld_Barn_03") :: MeshPart
			local frame = CFrame.new(shell.CFrame.Position.X, floorY, shell.CFrame.Position.Z)
				* shell.CFrame.Rotation
			for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
				for index, x in { -6, 6 } do
					local key = "Fence_0"
						.. tostring((houseIndex + index + (if side == 1 then 1 else 0)) % 3 + 1)
					decor(
						key,
						houseName .. "_Fence_" .. tostring(side) .. "_" .. tostring(index),
						frame * CFrame.new(x, 0, side * 12.5),
						6.5
					)
				end
			end
			for index = 1, 5 do
				local x = -15 - index % 2 * 1.8
				local z = (index - 3) * 3.3
				decor(
					"Rock_0" .. index,
					houseName .. "_Rock_" .. index,
					frame * CFrame.new(x, 0, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, index * 1.73, 0),
					1.1
				)
			end
		end
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			for index, z in { -240, -140, -60, 60, 140, 240 } do
				decor(
					"Fence_0" .. tostring(index % 3 + 1),
					"RoadFence_" .. side .. "_" .. index,
					CFrame.new(side * 11.5, floorY, z) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi / 2, 0),
					6.5
				)
			end
		end
		root:SetAttribute("HarvestCommonModels", count)
		local barn = Geometry.Template("BarnDark_Open")
		assert(barn:IsA("Model"), "Harvest dark barn template required")
		for _, source in sources do
			assert(source.Part.Transparency == 0, "Original barn transparency has author changes")
			local selected = {}
			local low, high =
				Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge),
				Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
			for _, part in barn:GetChildren() do
				assert(
					part:IsA("MeshPart"),
					"Harvest barn template must contain mesh primitives only"
				)
				local info = Geometry.MeshInfo(part:GetAttribute("HarvestMeshKey"))
				local name = info.sourceName:gsub("^HW_Dark_", ""):gsub("_Export$", "")
				if name == source.Name then
					table.insert(selected, part)
					local center, half = part.CFrame.Position, part.Size / 2
					low = Vector3.new(
						math.min(low.X, center.X - half.X),
						math.min(low.Y, center.Y - half.Y),
						math.min(low.Z, center.Z - half.Z)
					)
					high = Vector3.new(
						math.max(high.X, center.X + half.X),
						math.max(high.Y, center.Y + half.Y),
						math.max(high.Z, center.Z + half.Z)
					)
				end
			end
			assert(#selected > 0, "Dark barn source correspondence missing: " .. source.Name)
			local center, size = (low + high) / 2, high - low
			local ratio = source.Size / size
			assert(
				math.abs(ratio.X - 1) < 0.005
					and math.abs(ratio.Y - 1) < 0.005
					and math.abs(ratio.Z - 1) < 0.005,
				"Dark barn dimensions differ from original"
			)
			for index, part in selected do
				local copy = part:Clone()
				copy.Name = source.House .. "_" .. source.Name .. "_" .. index
				copy.CFrame = source.Frame * CFrame.new((part.CFrame.Position - center) * ratio)
				copy.Size = part.Size * ratio
				freezePart(copy, "B")
				copy:SetAttribute("HarvestSourceHouse", source.House)
				copy:SetAttribute("HarvestSourceName", source.Name)
				copy:SetAttribute("HarvestSourceFrame", source.Frame)
				copy:SetAttribute("HarvestSourceSize", source.Size)
				copy:SetAttribute("HarvestSourceTransparency", source.Part.Transparency)
				copy.Parent = detailed
			end
		end
		plane(
			detailed,
			"GroundSurface",
			ground.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, ground.Size.Y / 2 + 0.015, 0),
			Vector3.new(ground.Size.X, 0.02, ground.Size.Z),
			groundTexture("Ground_Tile_8"),
			8
		)
		local road = assert(props:FindFirstChild("VillageRoad")):FindFirstChild("RoadSurface")
		assert(
			road and road:IsA("BasePart") and road:GetAttribute("CornRoadExitOwned") == true,
			"Original road binding missing"
		)
		root:SetAttribute("HarvestRoadFrame", road.CFrame)
		root:SetAttribute("HarvestRoadSize", road.Size)
		plane(
			detailed,
			"RoadSurface",
			road.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, road.Size.Y / 2 + 0.035, 0),
			Vector3.new(road.Size.X, 0.02, road.Size.Z),
			groundTexture("Path_Tile_8"),
			8
		)
		seal(root)
	end)
	if not ok then
		root:Destroy()
		error("Harvest decor preparation failed; original world unchanged: " .. tostring(problem))
	end
	return root
end

-- In manual B the saved scene owns placement and appearance. Geometry remains
-- peer-local, so restore its mesh data without replaying the original layout or
-- comparing transforms with the old installation snapshot.
local function ensureManual(map: Model): any
	local currentMap, props = mapBinding()
	assert(
		currentMap == map and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B",
		"Manual Harvest authoring requires the accepted B map"
	)
	barnSources(props)
	local marker = homeBinding(props)
	local root = map:FindFirstChild("HarvestDecor")
	local home = marker:FindFirstChild("HarvestWardenHome")
	assert(
		root and root:IsA("Folder") and owned(root) and home and home:IsA("Folder") and owned(home),
		"Manual Harvest roots missing or foreign"
	)
	local targets = {}
	local parts = 0
	for _, item in map:GetDescendants() do
		if item:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner") ~= OWNER then
			continue
		end
		assert(owned(item), "Foreign manual Harvest metadata preserved")
		assert(
			item:IsA("Folder") or item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Texture"),
			"Unsupported manual Harvest instance preserved: " .. item:GetFullName()
		)
		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			assert(
				(item.ClassName == "Part" or item:IsA("MeshPart"))
					and item.Anchored
					and not item.CanCollide
					and not item.CanTouch
					and not item.CanQuery,
				"Manual Harvest art must remain anchored decoration"
			)
			parts += 1
			if item:IsA("MeshPart") then
				local key = item:GetAttribute("HarvestMeshKey")
				assert(
					type(key) == "string" and Geometry.MeshInfo(key),
					"Manual Harvest mesh key missing"
				)
				table.insert(targets, { Part = item, Key = key })
			end
		end
	end
	assert(#targets > 0, "Manual Harvest visual meshes missing")
	for _, target in targets do
		assert(
			map.Parent == world
				and target.Part:IsDescendantOf(map)
				and owned(target.Part)
				and map:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
				and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B",
			"Manual Harvest binding changed during restoration"
		)
		Geometry.Apply(target.Part, target.Key)
	end
	return {
		variant = "B",
		created = 0,
		changed = 0,
		parts = parts,
		commonModels = root:GetAttribute("HarvestCommonModels") or 0,
	}
end

function HarvestWorld.Ensure(requested: string?): any
	local candidate = world:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		candidate
		and candidate:IsA("Model")
		and candidate:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
	then
		assert(requested == nil or requested == "B", "Manual B cannot switch art variants")
		return ensureManual(candidate)
	end
	local declared = candidate and candidate:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant")
	assert(
		declared == nil or declared == "A" or declared == "B",
		"Unknown authored Harvest variant preserved"
	)
	if
		requested == nil and (not candidate or candidate:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == nil)
	then
		return { variant = "legacy", created = 0, changed = 0, parts = 0, commonModels = 0 }
	end
	local map, props, ground = mapBinding()
	local variant = requested or map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant")
	if variant == nil then
		return { variant = "legacy", created = 0, changed = 0, parts = 0, commonModels = 0 }
	end
	assert(variant == "A" or variant == "B", "Harvest variant must be A or B")
	local sources = barnSources(props)
	local root = map:FindFirstChild("HarvestDecor")
	local created = root == nil
	local previous = if root then root:GetAttribute("HarvestAppliedVariant") else "A"
	local marker = homeBinding(props)
	assert(
		(root ~= nil) == (marker:FindFirstChild("HarvestWardenHome") ~= nil),
		"Partial Harvest world roots preserved for review"
	)
	if root then
		assert(previous == "A" or previous == "B", "Unknown applied Harvest variant")
		validateDecor(root, props, previous)
		layoutBinding(root, props, ground)
	end
	local homeRoot, homeCreated, homeParts
	local prepared, preparationProblem = pcall(function()
		if not root then
			root = build(map, props, ground, sources)
		end
		layoutBinding(root, props, ground)
		homeRoot, homeCreated, homeParts = prepareHome(props, ground)
		assert(
			homeCreated or homeRoot:GetAttribute("HarvestAppliedVariant") == previous,
			"Harvest home/world variants differ"
		)
		for _, visualRoot in { root, homeRoot } do
			for _, part in visualRoot:GetDescendants() do
				if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
					Geometry.Apply(part, part:GetAttribute("HarvestMeshKey"))
				end
			end
		end
		local currentMap, currentProps, currentGround = mapBinding()
		assert(
			currentMap == map and currentProps == props and currentGround == ground,
			"Harvest world bindings changed during geometry restoration"
		)
		if not created then
			validateDecor(root, props, previous)
			validateDecor(homeRoot, props, previous)
			layoutBinding(root, props, ground)
			for _, part in homeParts do
				assert(
					part.Transparency == 1
						and equal(part.CFrame, homeRoot:GetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceFrame"))
						and equal(part.Size, homeRoot:GetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceSize")),
					"Author home changed during local geometry restoration"
				)
			end
			return
		end
		-- EditableMesh allocation yields. Recheck every author binding before publication.
		assert(
			map.Parent == world and not map:FindFirstChild("HarvestDecor"),
			"Harvest root changed while preparing"
		)
		for _, source in sources do
			assert(
				source.Part.Parent == props:FindFirstChild(source.House)
					and equal(source.Part.CFrame, source.Frame)
					and equal(source.Part.Size, source.Size)
					and source.Part.Transparency == 0,
				"Author barn changed during Harvest preparation"
			)
		end
		for _, part in homeParts do
			assert(
				part.Parent == marker
					and part.Transparency == 0
					and equal(part.CFrame, homeRoot:GetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceFrame"))
					and equal(part.Size, homeRoot:GetAttribute(part.Name .. "SourceSize")),
				"Author home changed during Harvest preparation"
			)
		end
	end)
	if not prepared then
		if created and root then
			root:Destroy()
		end
		if homeCreated and homeRoot then
			homeRoot:Destroy()
		end
		error(
			"Harvest preparation refused; original world unchanged: "
				.. tostring(preparationProblem)
		)
	end
	local changed, parts, journal = 0, 0, {}
	local function set(part: any, value: number)
		if part.Transparency ~= value then
			table.insert(journal, { Part = part, Value = part.Transparency })
			part.Transparency = value
			changed += 1
		end
	end
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		for _, visualRoot in { root, homeRoot } do
			for _, item in visualRoot:GetDescendants() do
				if item:IsA("BasePart") then
					parts += 1
					set(
						item,
						if visibleBranch(item:GetAttribute("HarvestBranch"), variant)
							then item:GetAttribute("HarvestVisibleTransparency")
							else 1
					)
					if item:GetAttribute("HarvestSourceName") then
						set(
							sourceFor(props, item),
							if variant == "B"
								then 1
								else item:GetAttribute("HarvestSourceTransparency")
						)
					end
				elseif item:IsA("Texture") then
					set(
						item,
						if visibleBranch(item:GetAttribute("HarvestBranch"), variant)
							then item:GetAttribute("HarvestVisibleTransparency")
							else 1
					)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, part in homeParts do
			set(part, 1)
		end
		root:SetAttribute("HarvestAppliedVariant", variant)
		homeRoot:SetAttribute("HarvestAppliedVariant", variant)
		if created then
			root.Parent = map
			homeRoot.Parent = marker
		end
		map:SetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant", variant)
	end)
	if not ok then
		for index = #journal, 1, -1 do
			journal[index].Part.Transparency = journal[index].Value
		end
		if created then
			root:Destroy()
			homeRoot:Destroy()
		else
			root:SetAttribute("HarvestAppliedVariant", previous)
			homeRoot:SetAttribute("HarvestAppliedVariant", previous)
		end
		error("Harvest appearance transaction rolled back: " .. tostring(problem))
	end
	return {
		variant = variant,
		created = if created then 1 else 0,
		changed = changed,
		parts = parts,
		commonModels = root:GetAttribute("HarvestCommonModels"),
	}
end

return HarvestWorld

--!strict
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Models = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ItemModels"))
local InventoryWorld = {}
InventoryWorld.__index = InventoryWorld

-- The marker is the authored item frame, including its height and yaw. It lives
-- in the same editable site Model as the slot, torch and stump preview.
local function authoredPoint(world: any, slot: BasePart, kind: string): CFrame?
	if world.Root:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") ~= 1 then
		return nil
	end
	assert(world.Root:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B", "Manual item sites require B")
	local site = slot.Parent
	assert(
		site
			and site:IsA("Model")
			and site.Parent == world.Root:FindFirstChild("KeySlots")
			and site.PrimaryPart == slot,
		"Manual item slot must be the site PrimaryPart"
	)
	local point = site:FindFirstChild(if kind == "energy" then "EnergyPoint" else "TrapPoint", true)
	assert(
		point
			and point:IsA("BasePart")
			and point:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and point:GetAttribute("BAuthoringHelper") == true
			and point:GetAttribute("BAuthoringPoint") == kind
			and point.Anchored
			and point.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) > 0.999,
		"Manual item point missing or invalid: " .. slot.Name .. "/" .. kind
	)
	local position = point.CFrame.Position
	assert(
		position.X == position.X
			and position.Y == position.Y
			and position.Z == position.Z
			and math.abs(position.X) < 10000000
			and math.abs(position.Y) < 10000000
			and math.abs(position.Z) < 10000000
			and world:IsOnPlayground(position),
		"Manual item point is outside PlayBounds"
	)
	return point.CFrame
end

function InventoryWorld.new(world: any, random: Random, keySlot: BasePart, onPickup: any): any
	local authoredPoints: { [BasePart]: { [string]: CFrame } } = {}
	if world.Root:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1 then
		-- Refuse an incomplete hand-edited site before creating runtime items.
		for _, slot in world.Slots do
			authoredPoints[slot] = {
				energy = assert(authoredPoint(world, slot, "energy")),
				trap = assert(authoredPoint(world, slot, "trap")),
			}
		end
	end
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "InventoryItems"
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_inventory_owned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	folder.Parent = world.Runtime
	local lookouts = Instance.new("Folder")
	lookouts.Name = "LookoutStumps"
	lookouts:SetAttribute("corn_inventory_owned", true)
	lookouts:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
	lookouts.Parent = folder
	local self = setmetatable(
		{ world = world, folder = folder, pickups = {}, traps = {}, connections = {} },
		InventoryWorld
	)
	local slots = table.clone(world.Slots)
	for index = #slots, 2, -1 do
		local other = random:NextInteger(1, index)
		slots[index], slots[other] = slots[other], slots[index]
	end
	local used = 0
	for _, slot in slots do
		if slot == keySlot then
			continue
		end
		used += 1
		local kind = if used <= 2 then "energy" else "trap"
		local position = Vector3.new(
			slot.Position.X + (if kind == "energy" then 3.6 else -3.6),
			world.Ground.Position.Y + world.Ground.Size.Y / 2,
			slot.Position.Z
		)
		local authored = if authoredPoints[slot] then authoredPoints[slot][kind] else nil
		local frame = authored
			or CFrame.new(
				position
					+ Vector3.new(
						0,
						if kind == "energy" then Models.StumpHeight + 0.68 else 0.22,
						0
					)
			)
		local object, anchor
		if kind == "energy" then
			object, anchor = Models.Energy(frame)
		else
			object, anchor = Models.Trap(frame)
		end
		object.Name = "Pickup" .. used
		object:SetAttribute("item_kind", kind)
		object:SetAttribute("item_id", tostring(used))
		object:AddTag("corn_item_pickup")
		if kind == "energy" then
			local lookout = Instance.new("Model")
			lookout.Name = "Lookout" .. used
			lookout:SetAttribute("corn_inventory_owned", true)
			lookout:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", "children_of_corn")
			lookout:SetAttribute("LookoutVersion", 1)
			lookout:AddTag("corn_lookout_stump")
			lookout.PrimaryPart = Models.Stump(
				lookout,
				if authored
					then authored * CFrame.new(0, -Models.StumpHeight / 2 - 0.68, 0)
					else CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, Models.StumpHeight / 2, 0))
			)
			lookout.Parent = lookouts
		end
		local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.Name = "CornItemPrompt"
		prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
		prompt.ActionText = "Подобрать"
		prompt.ObjectText = if kind == "energy" then "Энергетик" else "Капкан"
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = world.Radius
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = true
		prompt.Parent = anchor
		local entry = { model = object, anchor = anchor, prompt = prompt, kind = kind }
		table.insert(self.pickups, entry)
		table.insert(
			self.connections,
			prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
				onPickup(player, entry)
			end)
		)
		object.Parent = folder
		if used == 4 then
			break
		end
	end
	return self
end
function InventoryWorld:SetEnabled(enabled: boolean)
	for _, entry in self.pickups do
		if entry.model.Parent then
			entry.prompt.Enabled = enabled
		end
	end
end
function InventoryWorld:Take(entry: any): boolean
	if not table.find(self.pickups, entry) or entry.model.Parent ~= self.folder then
		return false
	end
	entry.prompt.Enabled = false
	entry.model:Destroy()
	return true
end
function InventoryWorld:Place(root: BasePart, character: Model): boolean
	if #self.traps >= 2 then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	-- Runtime lookouts are real collision surfaces. Do not place through their
	-- wood; other owned items/NPC are noncollidable and are skipped by the ray.
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local hit = Workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -9, 0), params)
	local props = self.world.Root:FindFirstChild("Props")
	local road = if props then props:FindFirstChild("VillageRoad") else nil
	if
		not hit
		or (hit.Instance ~= self.world.Ground and not (road and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(road)))
		or not self.world:IsOnPlayground(hit.Position)
	then
		return false
	end
	local object, anchor = Models.Trap(CFrame.new(hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0)))
	object.Name = "PlacedTrap" .. (#self.traps + 1)
	object:AddTag("corn_placed_trap")
	object:SetAttribute("item_kind", "trap")
	object.Parent = self.folder
	table.insert(self.traps, { model = object, position = anchor.Position, spent = false })
	return true
end
function InventoryWorld:CheckTraps(hunt: any, from: Vector3?, now: number): boolean
	local at = hunt:GetPosition()
	if not at or hunt.state == "trapped" then
		return false
	end
	local start = from or at
	local segment = Vector3.new(at.X - start.X, 0, at.Z - start.Z)
	for _, trap in self.traps do
		if trap.spent then
			continue
		end
		local offset = Vector3.new(trap.position.X - start.X, 0, trap.position.Z - start.Z)
		local t = if segment.Magnitude > 0
			then math.clamp(offset:Dot(segment) / segment:Dot(segment), 0, 1)
			else 0
		local closest = start + (at - start) * t
		if
			Vector3.new(closest.X - trap.position.X, 0, closest.Z - trap.position.Z).Magnitude
				<= 2.3
			and math.abs(closest.Y - trap.position.Y) <= 5
			and hunt:Stun(now, 10)
		then
			trap.spent = true
			trap.model:SetAttribute("Triggered", true)
			local closed = Models.Trap(CFrame.new(trap.position), true)
			closed.Name = "SpentTrap"
			closed.Parent = self.folder
			trap.model:Destroy()
			task.delay(10, function()
				closed:Destroy()
			end)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end
function InventoryWorld:Destroy()
	for _, connection in self.connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self.folder:Destroy()
	table.clear(self.pickups)
	table.clear(self.traps)
end
return InventoryWorld
