--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Assets = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioAssets"))
local Rules = require(Shared:WaitForChild("AudioRules"))
local Layout = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CornLayout"))

local RoundAudio = {}
RoundAudio.__index = RoundAudio

local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local LOOP_KEY = "COC_Corn_Continuous_02"
local VOICE_KEYS = Rules.VoiceKeys
local ARRIVAL_KEYS = { [2] = "COC_Monster_01", [3] = "COC_Monster_02" }

local function finite(value: number): boolean
	return value == value and value > -math.huge and value < math.huge
end

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornAudioOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
end

local function annotate(item: Instance, role: string)
	item:SetAttribute("CornAudioOwned", true)
	item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	item:SetAttribute("audio_role", role)
end

local function stop(sound: Sound)
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= false then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
		sound:Stop()
	end
end

local function request(sound: Sound, playing: boolean)
	if not playing then
		stop(sound)
	elseif sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= true then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", true)
		-- An empty ID is configuration awaiting import, not loaded audio.
		if sound.SoundId ~= "" then
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
end

-- Preserve an inserted foreign child even when its owned parent is removed.
local function destroyOwned(item: Instance)
	if not owned(item) then
		return
	end
	local safeParent = item.Parent
	while safeParent and owned(safeParent) do
		safeParent = safeParent.Parent
	end
	local descendants = item:GetDescendants()
	for _, child in descendants do
		if not owned(child) and child.Parent and owned(child.Parent) then
			child.Parent = safeParent
		end
	end
	item:Destroy()
end

function RoundAudio:_remember(item: Instance, role: string)
	annotate(item, role)
	table.insert(self.created, item)
	return item
end

function RoundAudio:_remove(item: Instance)
	if item:IsA("Sound") then
		stop(item)
	end
	destroyOwned(item)
	local index = table.find(self.created, item)
	if index then
		table.remove(self.created, index)
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_sound(
	parent: Instance,
	key: string,
	role: string,
	volume: number,
	category: string,
	range: any,
	looped: boolean
): Sound
	local definition = Assets.Get(key)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = "CornAudio_" .. role
	self:_remember(sound, role)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioAssetKey", key)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", false)
	sound.SoundId = definition.Id
	sound.Volume = math.clamp(volume * definition.Gain, 0, 1)
	sound.Looped = looped
	sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	sound.RollOffMinDistance = range.Min
	sound.RollOffMaxDistance = range.Max
	sound.SoundGroup = self.groups[category]
	sound.Parent = parent
	return sound
end

function RoundAudio:_reinforcementIndex(hunt: any): number?
	if type(hunt) ~= "table" or hunt.destroyed ~= false or hunt.world ~= self.world then
		return nil
	end
	local model, root = hunt.model, hunt.root
	if
		typeof(model) ~= "Instance"
		or not model:IsA("Model")
		or typeof(root) ~= "Instance"
		or not root:IsA("BasePart")
		or typeof(self.world.Runtime) ~= "Instance"
		or self.world.Runtime.Parent ~= self.world.Root
		or self.world.Runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or model.Parent ~= self.world.Runtime
		or model:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
		or model:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
		or model:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
		or root.Parent ~= model
		or root.Name ~= "Root"
		or model.PrimaryPart ~= root
	then
		return nil
	end
	local index = model:GetAttribute("MonsterIndex")
	if
		(index ~= 2 and index ~= 3)
		or model.Name ~= "Monster" .. tostring(index)
		or not ({ patrol = true, chase = true, trapped = true, capturing = true })[hunt.state]
	then
		return nil
	end
	return index
end

function RoundAudio:_arrivalGroupOwned(group: any): boolean
	return typeof(group) == "Instance"
		and group:IsA("SoundGroup")
		and self.groups.Effects == group
		and group.Parent == self.arrivalGroupsFolder
		and group.Name == "Effects"
		and owned(group)
		and group:GetAttribute("audio_role") == "group_Effects"
		and self.arrivalGroupsFolder.Parent == SoundService
		and owned(self.arrivalGroupsFolder)
		and self.arrivalGroupsFolder:GetAttribute("audio_role") == "groups"
end

function RoundAudio:_arrivalOwned(entry: any): boolean
	local sound, group = entry.sound, entry.group
	return self:_reinforcementIndex(entry.hunt) == entry.index
		and entry.hunt.root == entry.root
		and entry.hunt.model == entry.model
		and sound.Parent == entry.root
		and owned(sound)
		and sound.Name == "CornAudio_" .. entry.role
		and sound:GetAttribute("audio_role") == entry.role
		and sound:GetAttribute("AudioAssetKey") == entry.key
		and sound.SoundId == entry.id
		and not sound.Looped
		and sound.SoundGroup == group
		and self:_arrivalGroupOwned(group)
end

-- Only SoloRound's successful authoritative two-NPC spawn calls this method.
-- Binding or synchronizing an existing hunt in Step never emits an arrival.
function RoundAudio:ReinforcementsSpawned(hunts: any): number
	if self.destroyed or type(hunts) ~= "table" or #hunts ~= 2 then
		return 0
	end
	for key in hunts do
		if key ~= 1 and key ~= 2 then
			return 0
		end
	end
	local byIndex = {}
	for _, hunt in hunts do
		local index = self:_reinforcementIndex(hunt)
		if not index or byIndex[index] then
			return 0
		end
		byIndex[index] = hunt
	end
	if not byIndex[2] or not byIndex[3] then
		return 0
	end
	local pending = {}
	for index = 2, 3 do
		if not self.arrivalSeen[index] then
			-- Consume both appearances before any playback can notify observers.
			self.arrivalSeen[index] = true
			pending[index] = true
		end
	end
	local requested = 0
	for index = 2, 3 do
		-- Replaced roots, handoffs and revival cannot replay a round's appearance.
		if not pending[index] or not self:_arrivalGroupOwned(self.groups.Effects) then
			continue
		end
		local hunt, key = byIndex[index], ARRIVAL_KEYS[index]
		local role = "reinforcement_arrival_" .. tostring(index)
		local sound = self:_sound(
			hunt.root,
			key,
			role,
			Rules.Volume.Awakening,
			"Effects",
			Rules.Ranges.Awakening,
			false
		)
		-- These sounds have a stricter ownership lifecycle than legacy voices.
		-- Keep them outside generic cleanup so a foreign takeover is preserved.
		local createdIndex = table.find(self.created, sound)
		if createdIndex then
			table.remove(self.created, createdIndex)
		end
		sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
		local entry = {
			hunt = hunt,
			index = index,
			model = hunt.model,
			root = hunt.root,
			sound = sound,
			group = self.groups.Effects,
			key = key,
			role = role,
			id = Assets.Get(key).Id,
		}
		if self:_arrivalOwned(entry) then
			self.arrivals[index] = entry
			request(sound, true)
			requested += 1
		end
	end
	return requested
end

function RoundAudio:_stepArrivals(caught: boolean, removing: boolean?)
	for index, entry in self.arrivals do
		if not self:_arrivalOwned(entry) then
			-- Foreign identity, parent, URI or group: relinquish without any writes.
			self.arrivals[index] = nil
		elseif removing then
			stop(entry.sound)
			destroyOwned(entry.sound)
			self.arrivals[index] = nil
		elseif caught then
			stop(entry.sound)
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_stepCricket(entry: any, now: number)
	local sound = entry.sound
	local elapsed = now - self.startedAt - entry.offset
	local inSlot = Rules.CricketIsOn(now, self.startedAt, entry.offset)
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying") ~= inSlot then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioRequestedPlaying", inSlot)
	end
	if elapsed < 0 then
		sound.Volume = 0
		return
	end
	local cycle = math.floor(elapsed / Rules.Cycle)
	local slotAt = self.startedAt + entry.offset + cycle * Rules.Cycle
	if cycle ~= entry.cycle then
		-- A stalled/unavailable request stayed silent. Cancel only that
		-- never-decoded attempt before considering a later scheduled slot.
		if entry.requestedAt and not entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned then
			if not sound.IsLoaded and sound.TimePosition == 0 then
				sound:Stop()
			end
		end
		entry.cycle = cycle
		entry.requestedAt, entry.playBeganAt = nil, nil
		entry.abandoned = false
		-- One attempt per slot; no replay of missed slots after a stall.
		if
			inSlot
			and now - slotAt <= Rules.CricketStartWindow
			and sound.SoundId ~= ""
			and not sound.IsPlaying
		then
			sound.Volume = 0
			sound.TimePosition = 0
			entry.requestedAt = now
			entry.startDeadline = slotAt + Rules.CricketStartWindow
			sound:Play()
		end
	end
	if entry.requestedAt and not entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned then
		local progressed = finite(sound.TimePosition) and sound.TimePosition > 0
		if now <= entry.startDeadline and ((sound.IsLoaded and sound.IsPlaying) or progressed) then
			-- Fade from the first observed decode/playback, never jump to the
			-- historical gain of a partially elapsed slot after cold loading.
			entry.playBeganAt = now
		elseif now >= entry.startDeadline then
			entry.abandoned = true
			if not sound.IsLoaded and not progressed then
				sound:Stop()
			end
		end
	end
	local alpha = 0
	if inSlot and entry.playBeganAt and not entry.abandoned and sound.IsPlaying then
		local played = math.max(0, now - entry.playBeganAt)
		local length = entry.duration
		if finite(sound.TimeLength) and sound.TimeLength > 0 then
			length = math.min(length, sound.TimeLength)
		end
		local progress = if finite(sound.TimePosition)
			then math.max(played, sound.TimePosition)
			else played
		alpha = Rules.CricketEnvelope(played, slotAt + Rules.CricketOn - now, length - progress)
	end
	-- Normal off is silence followed by natural Ended, never a timer Stop.
	sound.Volume = entry.gain * alpha
end

function RoundAudio.new(world: any, ownerPlayer: Player, hunt: any, random: Random?)
	assert(world.Root and world.Root:IsA("Model"), "Round audio requires a bound map")
	assert(world.Field and world.Field:IsA("BasePart"), "Round audio requires Field")
	assert(world.Runtime and world.Ground, "Round audio requires runtime and Ground")
	local self = setmetatable({
		world = world,
		ownerPlayer = ownerPlayer,
		random = random or Random.new(),
		created = {} :: { Instance },
		groups = {} :: { [string]: SoundGroup },
		crickets = {},
		fires = {} :: { Sound },
		actors = {} :: { [Player]: any },
		npc = nil :: any,
		npcActors = {} :: { [BasePart]: any },
		primaryHunt = nil :: any,
		leadHunt = nil :: any,
		voiceRoot = nil :: BasePart?,
		voices = {} :: { Sound },
		voiceBag = {} :: { number },
		voiceLast = 0,
		voiceUntil = 0,
		voiceAt = 0,
		chasing = false,
		wakeObservedDormant = hunt and hunt.state == "dormant",
		wakePlayed = false,
		wakePrimaryRoot = nil :: BasePart?,
		wakeUntil = 0,
		arrivals = {},
		arrivalSeen = {},
		startedAt = nil :: number?,
		pollAt = -math.huge,
		destroyed = false,
		exclusions = Layout.ReadExclusions(world.Root, world.Field),
	}, RoundAudio)
	local id = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(folder, "runtime")
	folder.Parent = world.Runtime
	self.folder = folder
	local wakeAnchor = Instance.new("Part")
	wakeAnchor.Name = "AwakeningEmitter"
	self:_remember(wakeAnchor, "awakening_emitter")
	wakeAnchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
	wakeAnchor.Size = Vector3.one
	wakeAnchor.Transparency = 1
	wakeAnchor.Anchored = true
	wakeAnchor.CanCollide = false
	wakeAnchor.CanTouch = false
	wakeAnchor.CanQuery = false
	wakeAnchor.CastShadow = false
	wakeAnchor.Position = if hunt and hunt.home then hunt.home else world.Field.Position
	wakeAnchor.Parent = folder
	local groupsFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	groupsFolder.Name = "CornRoundAudio_" .. id
	self:_remember(groupsFolder, "groups")
	groupsFolder.Parent = SoundService
	self.arrivalGroupsFolder = groupsFolder
	for _, category in { "Music", "Ambience", "Effects" } do
		local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
		group.Name = category
		self:_remember(group, "group_" .. category)
		group.Volume = math.clamp(Rules.Mix.Master * Rules.Mix[category], 0, 1)
		group.Parent = groupsFolder
		self.groups[category] = group
	end
	self.wakeSound = self:_sound(
		wakeAnchor,
		"COC_Monster_03",
		"awakening",
		Rules.Volume.Awakening,
		"Effects",
		Rules.Ranges.Awakening,
		false
	)
	self.wakeSound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.Linear
	local half = world.Field.Size / 2
	for index, offset in
		{
			Vector2.new(-0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, -0.62),
			Vector2.new(0, 0),
			Vector2.new(-0.62, 0.62),
			Vector2.new(0.62, 0.62),
		}
	do
		local anchor = Instance.new("Part")
		anchor.Name = "Crickets" .. index
		self:_remember(anchor, "crickets_emitter")
		anchor:AddTag("corn_audio_emitter")
		anchor.Size = Vector3.one
		anchor.Transparency = 1
		anchor.Anchored = true
		anchor.CanCollide = false
		anchor.CanTouch = false
		anchor.CanQuery = false
		anchor.CastShadow = false
		anchor.Position = world.Field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
			Vector3.new(offset.X * half.X, -half.Y + 1, offset.Y * half.Z)
		)
		anchor.Parent = folder
		local sound = self:_sound(
			anchor,
			"COC_Crickets_15s",
			"crickets",
			Rules.Volume.Crickets,
			"Ambience",
			Rules.Ranges.Crickets,
			false
		)
		local gain = sound.Volume
		sound.Volume = 0
		table.insert(self.crickets, {
			sound = sound,
			offset = (index - 1) * Rules.Cycle / 5,
			gain = gain,
			duration = math.max(0.1, Assets.Get("COC_Crickets_15s").Duration),
			cycle = -1,
			requestedAt = nil,
			playBeganAt = nil,
			abandoned = false,
		})
	end
	local markers = world.Root:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
	if
		markers
		and markers:GetAttribute("CornTorchMarkersOwned") == true
		and markers:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
	then
		-- Manual B sites own their torch Models; each Flame remains the real
		-- positional sound anchor after the author moves either Model.
		local manual = world.Root:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
			and world.Root:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
		local torches = if manual then world.Root:GetDescendants() else markers:GetChildren()
		for _, torch in torches do
			if
				torch:IsA("Model")
				and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true
				and torch:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
				and torch:HasTag("corn_torch")
			then
				local flame = torch:FindFirstChild("Flame")
				if flame and flame:IsA("BasePart") then
					table.insert(
						self.fires,
						self:_sound(
							flame,
							"COC_Fire",
							"fire",
							Rules.Volume.Fire,
							"Ambience",
							Rules.Ranges.Fire,
							true
						)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt)
	return self
end

function RoundAudio:_setHunt(hunt: any, hunts: { any }?)
	local desired = {} :: { [BasePart]: any }
	self.primaryHunt = nil
	-- Exactly three authoritative sources, without a Workspace/field scan.
	for index = 1, 3 do
		local source = if hunts then hunts[index] else (if index == 1 then hunt else nil)
		local root = if source and not source.destroyed then source.root else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") and root.Parent and not desired[root] then
			desired[root] = source
			if index == 1 then
				self.primaryHunt = source
			end
		end
	end
	if not self.wakePlayed then
		local primary = self.primaryHunt
		local root = if primary then primary.root else nil
		if self.wakePrimaryRoot ~= root then
			self.wakePrimaryRoot = root
			self.wakeObservedDormant = primary ~= nil and primary.state == "dormant"
			if primary then
				self.wakeSound.Parent.Position = primary.home or self.world.Field.Position
			end
		elseif primary and primary.state == "dormant" then
			self.wakeObservedDormant = true
		end
	end
	-- Remove only vanished NPCs before adding replacements; the live corn pool
	-- stays bounded at three and lead handoffs never cut another NPC's tail.
	for root, actor in self.npcActors do
		if not desired[root] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.npcActors[root] = nil
		end
	end
	for root, source in desired do
		local actor = self.npcActors[root]
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.npcActors[root] = actor
		end
		actor.hunt = source
	end
	local leadRoot = if hunt and not hunt.destroyed then hunt.root else nil
	local selected = if leadRoot then self.npcActors[leadRoot] else nil
	if not selected and self.primaryHunt then
		selected = self.npcActors[self.primaryHunt.root]
	end
	self.npc = selected -- Legacy alias for the selected voice/threat source.
	self.leadHunt = if selected then selected.hunt else nil
	local root = if selected then selected.root else nil
	if self.voiceRoot == root then
		return
	end
	for _, sound in self.voices do
		self:_remove(sound)
	end
	self.voices = {}
	self.voiceRoot = root
	self.voiceBag = {}
	self.voiceLast, self.voiceUntil, self.voiceAt = 0, 0, 0
	self.chasing = false
	if root then
		for index, key in VOICE_KEYS do
			self.voices[index] = self:_sound(
				root,
				key,
				"monster_voice_" .. index,
				Rules.Volume.Monster,
				"Effects",
				Rules.Ranges.Monster,
				false
			)
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_actor(root: BasePart): any
	-- This silent Sound is a replicated, owned movement binding only.
	local sound =
		self:_sound(root, LOOP_KEY, "corn_rustle", 0, "Effects", Rules.Ranges.Rustle, true)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioCornActive", false)
	sound:SetAttribute("AudioCornSpeed", 1)
	return { root = root, sound = sound, lastPosition = nil, lastAt = nil, playbackSpeed = 1 }
end

function RoundAudio:_inCorn(point: Vector3): boolean
	local field = self.world.Field
	local at = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	return math.abs(at.X) <= half.X
		and math.abs(at.Z) <= half.Z
		and not Layout.IsExcluded(point, self.exclusions)
end

function RoundAudio:_stepActor(actor: any, now: number, eligible: boolean)
	local root, sound = actor.root, actor.sound
	local point, before, beforeAt = root.Position, actor.lastPosition, actor.lastAt
	actor.lastPosition, actor.lastAt = point, now
	local dt = if beforeAt then now - beforeAt else 0
	local delta = if before then point - before else Vector3.zero
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	local moving = dt > 0
		and dt <= 1
		and distance >= 0.05
		and distance <= 12
		and distance / dt <= 45
		and math.abs(delta.Y) < 4
	local active = eligible == true and moving and self:_inCorn(point)
	local speed = 1
	if active then
		local stableRatio = actor.playerSpeed
		local hunt = actor.hunt
		if not stableRatio and hunt then
			local huntSpeed
			local character = self.ownerPlayer.Character
			local playerRoot = hunt.targetRoot
				or (if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil)
			if hunt.state == "chase" and playerRoot and type(hunt._chaseSpeed) == "function" then
				local ok, value = pcall(hunt._chaseSpeed, hunt, playerRoot, now)
				if ok then
					huntSpeed = value
				end
			elseif hunt.state == "patrol" and type(hunt.balance) == "table" then
				huntSpeed = hunt.balance.monster_patrol_speed
			end
			if type(huntSpeed) == "number" and finite(huntSpeed) and huntSpeed > 0 then
				stableRatio = huntSpeed / 10
			end
		end
		local ratio = stableRatio or distance / dt / 10
		ratio = math.floor(math.clamp(ratio, 1, 2) * 10 + 0.5) / 10
		-- NPC waypoint/physics noise must not modulate pitch every poll.
		speed = if stableRatio or math.abs(ratio - actor.playbackSpeed) >= 0.15
			then ratio
			else actor.playbackSpeed
	end
	actor.playbackSpeed = speed
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioCornSpeed") ~= speed then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioCornSpeed", speed)
	end
	if sound:GetAttribute("AudioCornActive") ~= active then
		sound:SetAttribute("AudioCornActive", active)
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_grounded(character: Model, humanoid: Humanoid, root: BasePart): boolean
	if humanoid.Health <= 0 or humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		return false
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local legHeight = 0
	if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
		local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
		if leg and leg:IsA("BasePart") then
			legHeight = leg.Size.Y
		end
	end
	local length = math.max(3, legHeight + humanoid.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 2)
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -length, 0), params)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance == self.world.Ground
end

function RoundAudio:_players(now: number, phase: string, eligible: ((Player) -> boolean)?)
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	table.sort(players, function(a, b)
		if a == b then
			return false
		elseif a == self.ownerPlayer then
			return true
		elseif b == self.ownerPlayer then
			return false
		end
		return a.UserId < b.UserId
	end)
	local alive: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if index > Rules.ActorLimit then
			break
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = if character then character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if
			not character
			or not humanoid
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or humanoid.Health <= 0
		then
			continue
		end
		alive[player] = true
		local actor = self.actors[player]
		if actor and actor.root ~= root then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			actor = nil
		end
		if not actor then
			actor = self:_actor(root)
			self.actors[player] = actor
		end
		actor.playerSpeed = if finite(humanoid.WalkSpeed)
			then math.clamp(humanoid.WalkSpeed / 12, 1, 2)
			else 1
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			(
				if eligible
					then eligible(player) == true
					else phase == "active" or player ~= self.ownerPlayer
			) and self:_grounded(character, humanoid, root)
		)
	end
	for player, actor in self.actors do
		if not alive[player] then
			self:_remove(actor.sound)
			self.actors[player] = nil
		end
	end
end

function RoundAudio:_voice(now: number)
	if now < self.wakeUntil then
		return
	end
	if now >= self.voiceUntil then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	end
	if now < self.voiceAt or #self.voices ~= 3 then
		return
	end
	if #self.voiceBag == 0 then
		self.voiceBag = { 1, 2, 3 }
		for index = #self.voiceBag, 2, -1 do
			local other = self.random:NextInteger(1, index)
			self.voiceBag[index], self.voiceBag[other] = self.voiceBag[other], self.voiceBag[index]
		end
		if self.voiceBag[1] == self.voiceLast then
			self.voiceBag[1], self.voiceBag[2] = self.voiceBag[2], self.voiceBag[1]
		end
	end
	local index = table.remove(self.voiceBag, 1)
	self.voiceLast = index
	local sound = self.voices[index]
	local definition = Assets.Get(VOICE_KEYS[index])
	self.voiceUntil = now + math.max(0.1, definition.Duration, sound.TimeLength)
	self.voiceAt = self.voiceUntil + self.random:NextNumber(Rules.VoiceMin, Rules.VoiceMax)
	request(sound, true)
end

function RoundAudio:Step(
	now: number,
	phase: string,
	mode: string,
	hunt: any,
	hunts: { any }?,
	eligible: ((Player) -> boolean)?
)
	if self.destroyed or not finite(now) then
		return
	end
	if phase ~= "active" and phase ~= "caught" then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
	self:_stepArrivals(phase == "caught")
	if not self.startedAt then
		self.startedAt = now
	end
	self:_setHunt(hunt, hunts)
	local primary = self.primaryHunt
	if phase == "caught" then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
		self.wakeUntil = 0
	elseif
		not self.wakePlayed
		and self.wakeObservedDormant
		and primary
		and not primary.destroyed
		and primary.state ~= "dormant"
		and primary.state ~= "stopped"
	then
		self.wakePlayed = true
		self.wakeUntil = now
			+ math.max(Assets.Get("COC_Monster_03").Duration, self.wakeSound.TimeLength)
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
		request(self.wakeSound, true)
	elseif self.wakePlayed and now >= self.wakeUntil then
		stop(self.wakeSound)
	end
	for _, entry in self.crickets do
		self:_stepCricket(entry, now)
	end
	for _, sound in self.fires do
		request(sound, mode == "medium" or mode == "hard")
	end
	local lead = self.leadHunt
	local chasing = phase == "active" and lead and not lead.destroyed and lead.state == "chase"
	if not chasing then
		for _, sound in self.voices do
			stop(sound)
		end
	elseif not self.chasing then
		self.voiceAt = now + Rules.FirstVoiceDelay
		self.voiceUntil = now
	end
	self.chasing = chasing == true
	if now < self.pollAt then
		return
	end
	self.pollAt = now + 0.1
	if self.chasing then
		self:_voice(now)
	end
	for _, actor in self.npcActors do
		local source = actor.hunt
		local floor = self.world.Ground.Position.Y + self.world.Ground.Size.Y / 2
		self:_stepActor(
			actor,
			now,
			phase == "active"
				and source
				and (source.state == "patrol" or source.state == "chase")
				and math.abs(actor.root.Position.Y - floor - 3) <= 3
		)
	end
	self:_players(now, phase, eligible)
end

function RoundAudio:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then
		return
	end
	self.destroyed = true
	self:_stepArrivals(false, true)
	for index = #self.created, 1, -1 do
		local item = self.created[index]
		if item:IsA("Sound") then
			stop(item)
		end
		destroyOwned(item)
	end
	self.created = {}
	self.actors = {}
	self.voices = {}
	self.fires = {}
	self.crickets = {}
	self.npc = nil
	self.npcActors = {}
	self.primaryHunt, self.leadHunt, self.voiceRoot = nil, nil, nil
	self.wakePrimaryRoot = nil
end

RoundAudio.Stop = RoundAudio.Destroy

return RoundAudio

StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GameC.source:
--!strict

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CornLayout = require(
	ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornLayout")
)

local CornBackdropController = { Name = "CornBackdropController", Order = 45 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local FOLDER_NAME = "CornClientBackdrop"
local STRIDE = 2
local MAX_PLANTS = 20000
local DETAILED_MAX_PLANTS = 30000
local CLONE_BUDGET = 18
local TIME_BUDGET = 0.002
local POLL_SEC = 1

local function owned(item: Instance): boolean
	return item:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

local function ownedTree(folder: Instance): boolean
	if not owned(folder) then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if not owned(item) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function staticArt(template: Instance): boolean
	for _, item in template:GetDescendants() do
		if
			item:IsA("LuaSourceContainer")
			or item:IsA("Sound")
			or item:IsA("ParticleEmitter")
			or item:IsA("Beam")
			or item:IsA("Trail")
			or item:IsA("ProximityPrompt")
			or item:IsA("ClickDetector")
			or item:IsA("RemoteEvent")
			or item:IsA("RemoteFunction")
		then
			return false
		end
	end
	return template.Archivable
end

function CornBackdropController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornBackdropController] " .. message)
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_bridge(folder: Folder): boolean
	local renderer = self._renderer
	return renderer ~= nil
		and typeof(renderer.UseBackdropReady) == "function"
		and renderer:UseBackdropReady(folder) == true
end

function CornBackdropController:_restoreOriginals()
	for part, previous in self._originals do
		if part.Parent then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = previous
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._originals)
end

function CornBackdropController:_clear()
	self._epoch += 1
	local folder = self._folder
	if folder and owned(folder) then
		self:_bridge(folder)
		folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	end
	self:_restoreOriginals()
	if folder then
		if ownedTree(folder) then
			folder:Destroy()
		else
			self:_warn(
				"Changed ownership or foreign backdrop content was preserved; saved overview restored"
			)
		end
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
	self._signature = nil
	self._ready = false
	self._count = 0
	self._detailed = false
	self._detailedTemplates = nil
end

function CornBackdropController:_publish(): boolean
	local folder, map = self._folder, self._map
	if not folder or not map or folder.Parent ~= map or not owned(folder) then
		return false
	end
	local overview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview")
	if
		not overview
		or not overview:IsA("Folder")
		or overview:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or overview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_warn("Unrecognized saved overview was preserved; backdrop not published")
		return false
	end
	local originals = overview:GetChildren()
	for _, part in originals do
		if
			not part:IsA("BasePart")
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Foreign saved overview content was preserved; backdrop not published")
			return false
		end
	end
	-- Bridge clears the old near-field mask before we capture its exact original LTM.
	-- No yield between bridge, capture/hide and publication.
	if not self:_bridge(folder) then
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	for _, item in originals do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		self._originals[part] = part.LocalTransparencyModifier
		part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
	end
	self._ready = true
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._count)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
	return true
end

function CornBackdropController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local authoredMap = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local authored = CornLayout.AuthoringSource(authoredMap)
	if
		authoredMap
		and authoredMap:IsA("Model")
		and authoredMap:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and authoredMap:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
		and authoredMap:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
		and authored
		and authored:IsA("Folder")
		and authored:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and authored:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
	then
		self:_clear()
		return false
	end
	if not self._renderer or typeof(self._renderer.UseBackdropReady) ~= "function" then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn("Near-field backdrop bridge unavailable; saved overview preserved")
		return false
	end
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if template and template:IsA("Model") then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn(
			"Backdrop needs a prepared BasePart template compatible with near-field coverage; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
		or not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
		or field.Size.X <= 0
		or field.Size.Z <= 0
		or not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or not template:IsA("BasePart")
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		or not staticArt(template)
	then
		self:_clear()
		self:_warn(
			"Owned horizontal field and prepared static art unavailable; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end
	local detailed = map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	local templates, appearance = self._detailedTemplates, self._appearance
	if detailed and not templates then
		if self._detailPreparing then
			return false
		end
		self._detailPreparing = true
		local epoch = self._epoch
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local module = require(
				ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared")
					:WaitForChild("Game")
					:WaitForChild("CornAppearance")
			)
			return { Appearance = module, Templates = module.DetailedTemplates() }
		end)
		self._detailPreparing = false
		if
			self._epoch ~= epoch
			or not map.Parent
			or map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") ~= "B"
		then
			return false
		end
		if not ok then
			self:_warn(
				"Detailed backdrop unavailable; saved overview preserved: " .. tostring(result)
			)
			return false
		end
		templates, appearance = result.Templates, result.Appearance
	end
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	local signature = exclusions.Signature
		.. "/template/"
		.. tostring(bounds)
		.. "/"
		.. tostring(size)
		.. (if detailed then "/variant/B" else "")
	local folder = self._folder
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._signature == signature
		and folder
		and folder.Parent == map
		and owned(folder)
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") == self._ready
		and (self._detailed == true) == detailed
	then
		return true
	end
	self:_clear()
	if map:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME) then
		self:_warn("Existing CornMap/CornClientBackdrop was preserved; no replacement attempted")
		return false
	end
	if self._failedSignature == signature then
		return false
	end
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	minColumn, minRow = math.ceil(minColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math.ceil(minRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE
	maxColumn, maxRow =
		math.floor(maxColumn / STRIDE) * STRIDE, math.floor(maxRow / STRIDE) * STRIDE
	local candidateCount = (math.floor((maxColumn - minColumn) / STRIDE) + 1)
		* (math.floor((maxRow - minRow) / STRIDE) + 1)
	local maxPlants = if detailed then DETAILED_MAX_PLANTS else MAX_PLANTS
	if candidateCount > maxPlants or candidateCount <= 0 then
		self:_warn(
			"Full-field grid exceeds the " .. maxPlants .. " plant cap; saved overview preserved"
		)
		return false
	end
	self._map, self._field, self._template = map, field, template
	self._detailed, self._detailedTemplates, self._appearance = detailed, templates, appearance
	self._exclusions, self._signature = exclusions, signature
	self._minColumn, self._maxColumn = minColumn, maxColumn
	self._minRow, self._maxRow = minRow, maxRow
	self._column, self._row = minColumn, minRow
	self._fieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._fieldSize = field.Size
	self._fieldYaw = math.atan2(-field.CFrame.LookVector.X, -field.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	folder:SetAttribute("Stride", STRIDE)
	folder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", STRIDE * CornLayout.SpacingFor(field))
	folder:SetAttribute("MaxPlants", maxPlants)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	if detailed then
		folder:SetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant", "B")
		folder:SetAttribute("HarvestCornLod", "Far")
	end
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornBackdropController:_advance()
	self._column += STRIDE
	if self._column > self._maxColumn then
		self._column = self._minColumn
		self._row += STRIDE
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_buildStep()
	local folder, field, template, exclusions =
		self._folder, self._field, self._template, self._exclusions
	if not folder or not field or not template or not exclusions or self._ready then
		return
	end
	if
		folder.Parent ~= self._map
		or not owned(folder)
		or field.CFrame ~= self._fieldFrame
		or field.Size ~= self._fieldSize
		or (self._map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B") ~= (self._detailed == true)
	then
		self:_clear()
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
		return
	end
	local epoch, start = self._epoch, self._clock()
	local created = 0
	local maxPlants = if self._detailed then DETAILED_MAX_PLANTS else MAX_PLANTS
	while
		self._epoch == epoch
		and self._row <= self._maxRow
		and created < CLONE_BUDGET
		and self._count < maxPlants
		and self._clock() - start < TIME_BUDGET
	do
		local column, row = self._column, self._row
		self:_advance()
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		position = CornLayout.TrailEdgePosition(position, exclusions)
		local source = if self._detailed
			then self._detailedTemplates.Far[self._appearance.Variety(column, row)]
			else template
		local plant = source:Clone()
		if not plant then
			error("Prepared backdrop plant could not be cloned")
		end
		plant.Name = string.format("Far_%d_%d", column, row)
		local parts = plant:GetDescendants()
		table.insert(parts, plant)
		for _, item in parts do
			item:SetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned", true)
			item:SetAttribute("CornEditorOverview", true)
			item:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
			item:SetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned", nil)
			if item:IsA("BasePart") then
				item.Anchored = true
				item.CanCollide = false
				item.CanTouch = false
				item.CanQuery = false
				item.CastShadow = self._detailed == true
			end
		end
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		local yaw = CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + self._fieldYaw
		plant:PivotTo(
			if self._detailed
				then self._appearance.DetailedPivot(plant, position, yaw)
				else CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant, position, yaw)
		)
		plant.Parent = folder
		created += 1
		self._count += 1
	end
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._count)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameClones", created)
	folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameSeconds", self._clock() - start)
	if self._row > self._maxRow then
		if not self:_publish() then
			local failed = self._signature
			self:_clear()
			self._failedSignature = failed
		end
	end
end

function CornBackdropController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveInputs()
	end
	self:_buildStep()
end

function CornBackdropController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and (
			context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
			or context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "team_local"
		)
	self._renderer = context.Controllers.CornController
	self._connection = nil
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._epoch = 0
	self._originals = {}
	self._ready = false
	self._count = 0
	self._lastWarning = ""
	self._pollElapsed = math.huge
	self._failedSignature = nil
end

function CornBackdropController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		local ok, problem = pcall(self._step, self, delta)
		if not ok then
			local failed = self._signature
			self:_clear()
			self._failedSignature = failed
			self:_warn("Backdrop build failed; saved overview restored: " .. tostring(problem))
		end
	end)
end

function CornBackdropController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clear()
	self._renderer = nil
end

return CornBackdropController

local function manualTorchMap(map: Instance?): boolean
	local authored = CornLayout.AuthoringSource(map)
	return map ~= nil
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
		and map:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
		and authored ~= nil
		and authored:IsA("Folder")
		and authored:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and authored:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
end

function CornController:_clearManualTorches()
	for _, connection in self._manualTorchConnections or {} do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	self._manualTorchConnections, self._manualTorchModels = {}, {}
	self._manualTorchMap, self._manualTorchRoots, self._manualTorches = nil, nil, nil
	self._manualTorchesDirty = true
end

function CornController:_manualTorchList(map: Model): { Model }
	local roots = {
		map:FindFirstChild("Props"),
		map:FindFirstChild("KeySlots"),
		map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers"),
	}
	local previous = self._manualTorchRoots
	if
		self._manualTorchMap ~= map
		or not previous
		or previous[1] ~= roots[1]
		or previous[2] ~= roots[2]
		or previous[3] ~= roots[3]
	then
		self:_clearManualTorches()
		self._manualTorchMap, self._manualTorchRoots = map, roots
		local function dirty()
			self._manualTorchesDirty = true
		end
		local function watch(item)
			if item:IsA("Model") and not self._manualTorchModels[item] then
				self._manualTorchModels[item] = true
				for _, name in { "CornTorchOwned", "corn_project_id" } do
					table.insert(
						self._manualTorchConnections,
						item:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(dirty)
					)
				end
			end
		end
		for _, branch in roots do
			if branch then
				for _, item in branch:GetDescendants() do
					watch(item)
				end
				table.insert(
					self._manualTorchConnections,
					branch.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
						watch(item)
						dirty()
					end)
				)
				table.insert(self._manualTorchConnections, branch.DescendantRemoving:Connect(dirty))
			end
		end
	end
	if self._manualTorchesDirty then
		local torches = {}
		for _, branch in roots do
			if branch then
				for _, item in branch:GetDescendants() do
					if
						item:IsA("Model")
						and item:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true
						and item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
					then
						table.insert(torches, item)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		self._manualTorches, self._manualTorchesDirty = torches, false
	end
	return self._manualTorches
end

function CornController:_warn(message: string)
	if self._lastWarning ~= message then
		self._lastWarning = message
		warn("[CornController] " .. message)
	end
end

local function overviewKeys(field: BasePart, part: BasePart): { string }
	local relative = field.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(part.CFrame)
	local half = part.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	-- Require completed fine groups across the entire rotated coarse footprint.
	-- The margin also covers the small deterministic cell stagger.
	local padding = spacing * 0.75
	local halfX = math.abs(relative.RightVector.X) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.X) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.X) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local halfZ = math.abs(relative.RightVector.Z) * half.X
		+ math.abs(relative.UpVector.Z) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(relative.LookVector.Z) * half.Z
		+ padding
	local fieldHalf = field.Size / 2
	local minX = math.max(relative.Position.X - halfX, -fieldHalf.X)
	local maxX = math.min(relative.Position.X + halfX, fieldHalf.X)
	local minZ = math.max(relative.Position.Z - halfZ, -fieldHalf.Z)
	local maxZ = math.min(relative.Position.Z + halfZ, fieldHalf.Z)
	local keys: { string } = {}
	if minX > maxX or minZ > maxZ then
		return keys
	end
	local width = spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local offset = spacing / 2
	for column = math.floor((minX + offset) / width), math.floor((maxX + offset) / width) do
		for row = math.floor((minZ + offset) / width), math.floor((maxZ + offset) / width) do
			table.insert(keys, column .. ":" .. row)
		end
	end
	return keys
end

function CornController:_showOverview()
	for _, entry in self._overviewParts do
		if entry.Hidden then
			if entry.Part.Parent then
				entry.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier = entry.PreviousModifier
			end
			entry.Hidden = false
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_invalidateOverview()
	if self._overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	self._overviewInvalid = true
	-- A changed footprint or ownership must never keep an old local coverage mask.
	self:_showOverview()
	self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
end

function CornController:_restoreOverview()
	for _, connection in self._overviewConnections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(self._overviewConnections)
	self._overviewInvalid = true
	self:_showOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = nil
	self._overviewRuntime = false
	self._overviewParts = {}
	self._overviewByChunk = {}
end

function CornController:_markOverviewChunk(key: string)
	for _, entry in self._overviewByChunk[key] or {} do
		self._overviewDirty[entry] = true
	end
end

local function ownedBackdrop(folder: Instance?, map: Model?): boolean
	return folder ~= nil
		and map ~= nil
		and folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop"
		and folder.Parent == map
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
end

function CornController:UseBackdropReady(folder: Folder): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not ownedBackdrop(folder, map)
	then
		return false
	end
	-- The backdrop calls this before capturing authored visibility and publishing Ready.
	-- It also calls it before releasing the runtime layer, while ownership is intact.
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	return true
end

function CornController:_bindOverview()
	local map = self._map
	local field = self._field
	local folder = if map then map:FindFirstChild("EditorFieldOverview") else nil
	local backdrop = if map then map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop") else nil
	local runtime = ownedBackdrop(backdrop, map) and backdrop:GetAttribute("Ready") == true
	if runtime then
		folder = backdrop
	end
	if not folder then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	if
		not field
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		self:_warn("Unrecognized EditorFieldOverview is preserved")
		return
	end
	if
		not self._overviewInvalid
		and self._overviewFolder == folder
		and self._overviewFieldFrame == field.CFrame
		and self._overviewFieldSize == field.Size
	then
		return -- Signals invalidate the index instead of scanning every saved plant every poll.
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	-- This pass does not yield or change visibility. The whole container must be owned.
	for _, item in children do
		if
			not item:IsA("BasePart")
			or item:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("EditorFieldOverview contains unowned objects; all were preserved")
			return
		end
	end
	self:_restoreOverview()
	self._overviewFolder = folder
	self._overviewRuntime = runtime
	self._overviewFieldFrame = field.CFrame
	self._overviewFieldSize = field.Size
	local function invalidate()
		self:_invalidateOverview()
	end
	local function watch(signal: RBXScriptSignal)
		table.insert(self._overviewConnections, signal:Connect(invalidate))
	end
	watch(folder.ChildAdded)
	watch(folder.ChildRemoved)
	watch(folder.AncestryChanged)
	watch(folder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Name"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
	watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
	if runtime then
		watch(folder.DescendantAdded)
		watch(folder.DescendantRemoving)
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornClientBackdropOwned"))
		watch(folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ready"))
	end
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
	watch(field:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
	for _, item in children do
		local part = item :: BasePart
		local entry: OverviewItem = {
			Part = part,
			PreviousModifier = part.LocalTransparencyModifier,
			Frame = part.CFrame,
			Size = part.Size,
			Keys = overviewKeys(field, part),
			Hidden = false,
		}
		self._overviewParts[part] = entry
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local items = self._overviewByChunk[key]
			if not items then
				items = {}
				self._overviewByChunk[key] = items
			end
			table.insert(items, entry)
		end
		-- The backdrop owns immutable client-only copies; authored overview stays editable.
		if not runtime then
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CFrame"))
			watch(part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("CornEditorOverview"))
			watch(part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"))
		end
	end
	self._overviewInvalid = false
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if chunk.Done then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
		end
	end
end

function CornController:_updateOverview()
	local folder = self._overviewFolder
	if not folder or self._overviewInvalid then
		return
	end
	if
		folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or (
			self._overviewRuntime
			and (not ownedBackdrop(folder, self._map) or folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		)
	then
		self:_restoreOverview()
		return
	end
	for entry in self._overviewDirty do
		local part = entry.Part
		if
			part.Parent ~= folder
			or part:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") ~= true
			or part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_restoreOverview()
			self:_warn("Overview ownership changed; its visibility was restored")
			return
		end
		local covered = #entry.Keys > 0
		for _, key in entry.Keys do
			local chunk = self._chunks[key]
			if not chunk or not chunk.Done or (self._overviewRuntime and chunk.Lod > 2) then
				covered = false
				break
			end
		end
		if covered ~= entry.Hidden then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = if covered then 1 else entry.PreviousModifier
			entry.Hidden = covered
		end
	end
	self._overviewDirty = {}
end

function CornController:_clearChunks()
	self:_showOverview()
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		chunk.Alive = false
		chunk.Folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._chunks = {}
	self._queue = {}
	self._plantCount = 0
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	end
end

function CornController:_clearInputs()
	self._inputEpoch = (self._inputEpoch or 0) + 1
	self:_clearChunks()
	self:_restoreOverview()
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._folder = nil
	self._map = nil
	self._field = nil
	self._template = nil
	self._exclusions = nil
	self._elevatedUntil = nil
	self._detailed = false
	self._detailedTemplates = nil
end

function CornController:_resolveInputs(): boolean
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	local field = if map then map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone") else nil
	local authored = CornLayout.AuthoringSource(map)
	if
		map
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
		and map:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
		and authored
		and authored:IsA("Folder")
		and authored:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and authored:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		-- Retain the existing torch-distance handling without running the grid.
		self._map = map
		self._field = if field and field:IsA("BasePart") then field else nil
		return false
	end
	local art = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CornRuntimeArt")
	local template = if art then art:FindFirstChild("CornPlantTemplate") else nil
	if not map or not map:IsA("Model") or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("The owned CornMap is not available; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not field
		or not field:IsA("BasePart")
		or field.CFrame.UpVector:Dot(Vector3.yAxis) < 0.9999
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("CornMap needs a horizontal FieldZone; editor preview is preserved")
		return false
	end
	if
		not art
		or not art:IsA("Folder")
		or art:GetAttribute("CornRuntimeArtOwned") ~= true
		or art:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or not template
		or (not template:IsA("Model") and not template:IsA("BasePart"))
		or template:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
	then
		self:_clearInputs()
		self:_warn("Prepared corn art is not available; check CornField Output")
		return false
	end
	local detailed = map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	if
		self._map == map
		and self._field == field
		and self._template == template
		and self._folder
		and (self._detailed == true) == detailed
	then
		return true
	end
	local templates, appearance = nil, nil
	if detailed then
		if self._detailPreparing then
			return false
		end
		self._detailPreparing = true
		local epoch = self._inputEpoch
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local module = require(GameShared:WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("CornAppearance"))
			return { Appearance = module, Templates = module.DetailedTemplates() }
		end)
		self._detailPreparing = false
		if
			self._inputEpoch ~= epoch
			or not map.Parent
			or map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") ~= "B"
		then
			return false
		end
		if not ok then
			self:_warn("Detailed corn unavailable; editor overview preserved: " .. tostring(result))
			return false
		end
		templates, appearance = result.Templates, result.Appearance
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	local existing = map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants")
	if existing then
		if
			not existing:IsA("Folder")
			or existing:GetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned") ~= true
			or existing:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		then
			self:_warn("Refused to replace unowned CornMap/CornClientPlants")
			return false
		end
		existing:Destroy()
	end
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(template)
	self._pivotOffset = template:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds):Inverse()
	self._height = size.Y
	self._map = map
	self._field = field
	self._template = template
	self._detailed = detailed
	self._detailedTemplates = templates
	self._appearance = appearance
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornClientPlants"
	folder:SetAttribute("CornClientRendererOwned", true)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT_ID)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", 0)
	if detailed then
		folder:SetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant", "B")
		folder:SetAttribute("NearPlantCap", appearance.DetailedNearPlantLimit)
	end
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	-- This client-only deletion never changes the author's saved scene or Props.
	local preview = map:FindFirstChild("EditorPreview")
	if
		preview
		and preview:IsA("Folder")
		and preview:GetAttribute("CornEditorPreview") == true
		and preview:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
	then
		preview:Destroy()
	end
	self._lastWarning = ""
	return true
end

function CornController:_lodForDistance(
	distance: number,
	previous: number?,
	mediumRadius: number
): number
	local dense = CornLayout.DenseRadius
	if previous == 1 then
		if distance <= (dense + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 2 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius + LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	elseif previous == 3 then
		if distance <= (dense - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then
			return 1
		end
		return if distance <= (mediumRadius - LOD_HYSTERESIS) ^ 2 then 2 else 3
	end
	return if distance <= dense ^ 2 then 1 elseif distance <= mediumRadius ^ 2 then 2 else 3
end

function CornController:_elevatedView(root: BasePart, now: number): boolean
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local rootHeight = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position).Y + field.Size.Y / 2
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local cameraHeight = if camera
		then field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(camera.CFrame.Position).Y + field.Size.Y / 2
		else 0
	if math.max(rootHeight, cameraHeight) > 6 then
		self._elevatedUntil = now + 2
	end
	return now < (self._elevatedUntil or 0)
end

function CornController:_reconcile(root: BasePart)
	if not self:_resolveInputs() then
		return
	end
	local map = self._map :: Model
	local field = self._field :: BasePart
	local folder = self._folder :: Folder
	self:_bindOverview()
	local exclusions = CornLayout.ReadExclusions(map, field)
	if self._exclusions and self._exclusions.Signature ~= exclusions.Signature then
		self:_clearChunks()
	end
	self._exclusions = exclusions
	local minColumn, maxColumn, minRow, maxRow = CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field)
	local localRoot = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	local width = spacing * CornLayout.ChunkCells
	local elevated = self:_elevatedView(root, os.clock())
	local radius = if elevated then CornLayout.ElevatedRadius else CornLayout.RenderRadius
	local mediumRadius = if elevated then ELEVATED_MEDIUM_RADIUS else CornLayout.MediumRadius
	local retainRadius = radius + RETAIN_MARGIN
	local backdrop = self._overviewFolder
	local backdropStride = if self._overviewRuntime and backdrop
		then backdrop:GetAttribute("DetailStride")
		else nil
	local backdropCoversSparse = typeof(backdropStride) == "number"
		and backdropStride <= spacing * 2
	folder:SetAttribute("ViewRadius", radius)
	folder:SetAttribute("ElevatedDetail", elevated)
	local desired: { any } = {}
	for chunkColumn = math.floor((localRoot.X - retainRadius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.X + retainRadius) / width) do
		for chunkRow = math.floor((localRoot.Z - retainRadius) / width), math.floor((localRoot.Z + retainRadius) / width) do
			local firstColumn = math.max(minColumn, chunkColumn * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastColumn = math.min(maxColumn, (chunkColumn + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			local firstRow = math.max(minRow, chunkRow * CornLayout.ChunkCells)
			local lastRow = math.min(maxRow, (chunkRow + 1) * CornLayout.ChunkCells - 1)
			if firstColumn > lastColumn or firstRow > lastRow then
				continue
			end
			local centerX = (firstColumn + lastColumn) * spacing / 2
			local centerZ = (firstRow + lastRow) * spacing / 2
			local distance = (centerX - localRoot.X) ^ 2 + (centerZ - localRoot.Z) ^ 2
			local key = chunkColumn .. ":" .. chunkRow
			local previous = self._chunks[key]
			if
				distance <= radius * radius
				or (previous and distance <= retainRadius * retainRadius)
			then
				local lod = self:_lodForDistance(
					distance,
					if previous then previous.Lod else nil,
					mediumRadius
				)
				if backdropCoversSparse and lod == 3 then
					continue -- Whole-field stride6 is already denser than sparse stride9.
				end
				table.insert(desired, {
					Key = key,
					Lod = lod,
					MinColumn = firstColumn,
					MaxColumn = lastColumn,
					MinRow = firstRow,
					MaxRow = lastRow,
					Distance = distance,
				})
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(desired, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local wanted: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local nearChunks = 0
	local maxChunks = if self._detailed then DETAILED_MAX_CHUNKS else MAX_CHUNKS
	for index, candidate in desired do
		if index > maxChunks then
			break
		end
		wanted[candidate.Key] = true
		local artLod = candidate.Lod
		if self._detailed then
			if candidate.Lod == 1 then
				nearChunks += 1
			end
			artLod = if candidate.Lod == 1
					and nearChunks <= self._appearance.DetailedNearChunkLimit
				then 1
				elseif candidate.Lod <= 2 then 2
				else 3
		end
		local chunk = self._chunks[candidate.Key]
		if
			chunk and (chunk.Lod ~= candidate.Lod or (self._detailed and chunk.ArtLod ~= artLod))
		then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = nil
			chunk = nil
		end
		if chunk then
			chunk.Distance = candidate.Distance
		else
			local chunkFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
			chunkFolder.Name = "Chunk_" .. candidate.Key
			chunkFolder:SetAttribute("DetailStride", candidate.Lod * spacing)
			if self._detailed then
				chunkFolder:SetAttribute("HarvestCornLod", ({ "Near", "Mid", "Far" })[artLod])
			end
			chunkFolder.Parent = folder
			chunk = {
				Key = candidate.Key,
				Lod = candidate.Lod,
				ArtLod = artLod,
				Folder = chunkFolder,
				MinColumn = candidate.MinColumn,
				MaxColumn = candidate.MaxColumn,
				MinRow = candidate.MinRow,
				MaxRow = candidate.MaxRow,
				Column = candidate.MinColumn,
				Row = candidate.MinRow,
				Distance = candidate.Distance,
				Count = 0,
				Alive = true,
				Done = false,
			}
			self._chunks[candidate.Key] = chunk
		end
	end
	for key, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not wanted[key] then
			self:_markOverviewChunk(key)
			chunk.Alive = false
			self._plantCount -= chunk.Count
			chunk.Folder:Destroy()
			self._chunks[key] = nil
		end
	end
	self._queue = {}
	for _, chunk in self._chunks do
		if not chunk.Done then
			table.insert(self._queue, chunk)
		end
	end
	table.sort(self._queue, function(a, b)
		return if a.Distance == b.Distance then a.Key < b.Key else a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_createBatch()
	local template = self._template
	local field = self._field
	local exclusions = self._exclusions
	if not template or not field or not exclusions then
		return
	end
	local began = os.clock()
	local _, fieldYaw = field.CFrame:ToOrientation()
	local examined = 0
	local created = 0
	local maxPlants = if self._detailed then DETAILED_MAX_PLANTS else MAX_PLANTS
	while
		#self._queue > 0
		and examined < CELL_BUDGET
		and created < CREATE_BUDGET
		and self._plantCount < maxPlants
		and os.clock() - began < TIME_BUDGET_SEC
	do
		local chunk = self._queue[1]
		if not chunk.Alive or chunk.Done then
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
			continue
		end
		local column = chunk.Column
		local row = chunk.Row
		chunk.Column += 1
		if chunk.Column > chunk.MaxColumn then
			chunk.Column = chunk.MinColumn
			chunk.Row += 1
		end
		if chunk.Row > chunk.MaxRow then
			chunk.Done = true
			self:_markOverviewChunk(chunk.Key)
			table.remove(self._queue, 1)
		end
		examined += 1
		if column % chunk.Lod ~= 0 or row % chunk.Lod ~= 0 then
			continue
		end
		local position = CornLayout.CellPosition(field, column, row)
		if CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions) then
			continue
		end
		position = CornLayout.TrailEdgePosition(position, exclusions)
		local source = template
		if self._detailed then
			local lod = ({ "Near", "Mid", "Far" })[chunk.ArtLod or 3]
			local variety = self._appearance.Variety(column, row)
			source = self._detailedTemplates[lod][variety]
		end
		local clone = source:Clone()
		if not clone then
			self:_warn("Prepared corn template is not Archivable")
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
		local plant = clone :: CornLayout.Plant
		plant.Name = "Corn"
		if self._detailed or chunk.Lod == 3 then
			local items = plant:GetDescendants()
			table.insert(items, plant)
			for _, item in items do
				if self._detailed and item:IsA("BasePart") then
					item.CastShadow = true
				elseif item:IsA("MeshPart") then
					item.CastShadow = false
				end
			end
		end
		CornLayout.ApplyVariation(plant, column, row)
		local yaw = CornLayout.CellYaw(column, row) + fieldYaw
		plant:PivotTo(
			if self._detailed
				then self._appearance.DetailedPivot(plant, position, yaw)
				else CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant, position, yaw)
		)
		plant.Parent = chunk.Folder
		chunk.Count += 1
		self._plantCount += 1
		created += 1
	end
	if self._folder then
		self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedPlants", self._plantCount)
	end
	self:_updateOverview()
end

function CornController:_step(delta: number)
	self._pollElapsed += delta
	if self._pollElapsed >= POLL_SEC then
		self._pollElapsed = 0
		local character = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = if character then character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			self:_reconcile(root)
			local currentMap = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
			local manual = manualTorchMap(currentMap)
			if not manual and self._manualTorchMap then
				self:_clearManualTorches()
			end
			local torches = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers")
			local torchModels = if manual
				then self:_manualTorchList(currentMap :: Model)
				elseif torches then torches:GetChildren()
				else nil
			if torchModels then
				for _, torch in torchModels do
					if torch:IsA("Model") and torch:GetAttribute("CornTorchOwned") == true then
						local distance = (torch:GetPivot().Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						for _, effect in torch:GetDescendants() do
							if effect:IsA("Fire") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 220
							elseif effect:IsA("PointLight") then
								effect.Enabled = self._torchesEnabled ~= false and distance < 90
							elseif effect:IsA("BasePart") and effect.Name == "Flame" then
								effect.LocalTransparencyModifier = if self._torchesEnabled
										== false
									then 1
									else math.clamp((distance - 240) / 80, 0, 1)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			self:_clearChunks()
		end
	end
	self:_createBatch()
end

function CornController:SetLightingMode(mode: string?)
	local enabled = mode ~= "easy"
	if self._torchesEnabled ~= enabled then
		self._torchesEnabled = enabled
		self._pollElapsed = POLL_SEC
	end
end

function CornController:Init(context: any)
	self._torchesEnabled = true
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and (
			context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
			or context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "team_local"
		)
end

function CornController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta: number)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornController:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearInputs()
	self:_clearManualTorches()
end

return CornController
