local function authoredTiles(map)
	local folder = assert(map:FindFirstChild("GreenBedEditor"), "Authored soil folder missing")
	assert(
		folder:IsA("Folder")
			and folder:GetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner") == OWNER
			and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT,
		"Foreign authored soil retained"
	)
	local result = {}
	for _, part in folder:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("Model") or part:IsA("Folder") then
			continue
		end
		assert(
			part:IsA("MeshPart")
				and part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner") == OWNER
				and part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryOwned") == true
				and #part:GetChildren() == 0,
			"Foreign authored soil content retained"
		)
		local key = part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryKey")
		local metadata = SOURCES[key]
		assert(
			metadata
				and part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedSourceSHA256") == metadata[2]
				and part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedSourceTriangles") == metadata[3],
			"Authored soil geometry binding changed"
		)
		for _, value in { part.CFrame:GetComponents() } do
			assert(value == value and math.abs(value) < math.huge, "Authored soil frame is invalid")
		end
		for _, value in { part.Size.X, part.Size.Y, part.Size.Z } do
			assert(
				value == value and value > 0 and value < math.huge,
				"Authored soil size is invalid"
			)
		end
		local transparency = part:GetAttribute("BManualSourceTransparency")
		if type(transparency) ~= "number" then
			transparency = part.Transparency
		end
		assert(
			transparency == transparency and transparency >= 0 and transparency <= 1,
			"Authored soil transparency is invalid"
		)
		if transparency < 1 then
			table.insert(result, {
				Key = key,
				Frame = part.CFrame,
				Size = part.Size,
				Source = part,
				Transparency = transparency,
			})
		end
	end
	return result
end

local function unchangedFrame(actual, expected)
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		return actual == expected
	end
	local values = { expected:GetComponents() }
	for index, value in { actual:GetComponents() } do
		if
			value ~= value
			or math.abs(value - values[index]) > (if index <= 3 then 0.0001 else 0.00025)
		then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function untouchedEditor(folder)
	if
		not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or not owned(folder)
		or #folder:GetTags() ~= 0
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
	then
		return false
	end
	for attribute in folder:GetAttributes() do
		if attribute ~= "BGreenBedsOwner" and attribute ~= "corn_project_id" then
			return false
		end
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	if #children ~= #Layout.SoilTiles then
		return false
	end
	local seen = {}
	for _, item in children do
		local index = item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedTile")
		if
			type(index) ~= "number"
			or index % 1 ~= 0
			or seen[index]
			or not Layout.SoilTiles[index]
		then
			return false
		end
		seen[index] = true
		local tile = Layout.SoilTiles[index]
		local source = SOURCES[tile.Key]
		if
			item.Name ~= source[1] .. "_" .. string.format("%04d", index)
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryOwned") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryKey") ~= tile.Key
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedSourceSHA256") ~= source[2]
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedSourceTriangles") ~= source[3]
			or not unchangedFrame(item.CFrame, tile.Frame)
			or item.Size ~= tile.Size
			or item.PivotOffset ~= CFrame.identity
			or item.TextureID ~= "rbxassetid://95855894892409"
			or item.Color ~= Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			or item.Material ~= Enum.Material.Plastic
			or item.Transparency ~= 0
			or item.Reflectance ~= 0
			or not item.Anchored
			or item.CanCollide
			or item.CanTouch
			or item.CanQuery
			or not item.CastShadow
			or not item.DoubleSided
			or #item:GetTags() ~= 0
		then
			return false
		end
		for attribute in item:GetAttributes() do
			if not PART_ATTRIBUTES[attribute] then
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Controller:_restore()
	for part, value in self._hidden do
		if part.Parent and (not self._manual or part.LocalTransparencyModifier == 1) then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = value
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._hidden)
	local saved = self._manual and self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("GreenBedEditor")
	if saved and saved:GetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner") == OWNER then
		for _, part in saved:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("MeshPart") and part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner") == OWNER then
				local opacity = part:GetAttribute("BManualSourceTransparency")
				if
					type(opacity) == "number"
					and opacity == opacity
					and opacity >= 0
					and opacity <= 1
					and part.Transparency == 1
				then
					part.Transparency = opacity
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function Controller:_clear()
	self._epoch += 1
	self:_restore()
	if self._folder and self._folder.Parent and owned(self._folder) then
		self._folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._folder, self._map = nil, nil
	self._tiles, self._manual = nil, false
	self._index = 1
	self._ready = false
end

function Controller:_build(map)
	self:_clear()
	self._map = map
	self._manual = manualMode(map)
	self._tiles = if self._manual then authoredTiles(map) else Layout.SoilTiles
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornClientGreenBeds"
	folder:SetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner", OWNER)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedParts", 0)
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	self._building = true
	local epoch = self._epoch
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, problem = pcall(Geometry.BuildTemplates)
		if epoch ~= self._epoch then
			return
		end
		self._building = false
		if not ok then
			self:_clear()
			self._failedMap = map
			warn("[GreenBedController] Saved preview retained: " .. tostring(problem))
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_step(delta)
	self._poll += delta
	if self._poll >= 1 then
		self._poll = 0
		local map = target()
		if map ~= self._map or (map and manualMode(map) ~= self._manual) then
			if map and map ~= self._failedMap then
				self:_build(map)
			else
				self:_clear()
			end
		end
	end
	if not self._map or not self._folder or self._building or self._ready then
		return
	end
	local start, count = os.clock(), 0
	local tiles = self._tiles
	while self._index <= #tiles and count < 8 and os.clock() - start < 0.002 do
		local tile = tiles[self._index]
		local item = Geometry.Clone(tile.Key, tile.Frame)
		item.Size = tile.Size
		if self._manual then
			item.Transparency = tile.Transparency
		end
		item:SetAttribute("BGreenBedTile", self._index)
		item.Parent = self._folder
		self._index += 1
		count += 1
	end
	self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedParts", self._index - 1)
	self._folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameClones", count)
	self._folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameSeconds", os.clock() - start)
	if self._index > #tiles then
		local saved = self._map:FindFirstChild("GreenBedEditor")
		if saved then
			if self._manual then
				for _, tile in tiles do
					self._hidden[tile.Source] = tile.Source.LocalTransparencyModifier
					tile.Source.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
			else
				assert(untouchedEditor(saved), "Manual editor beds preserved")
				for _, item in saved:GetChildren() do
					self._hidden[item] = item.LocalTransparencyModifier
					item.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
			end
		end
		self._ready = true
		self._folder:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
	end
end

function Controller:Init(context)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio() and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
	self._epoch, self._poll, self._index = 0, math.huge, 1
	self._hidden = {}
	self._ready, self._building = false, false
end

function Controller:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		local ok, problem = pcall(self._step, self, delta)
		if not ok then
			local failed = self._map
			self:_clear()
			self._failedMap = failed
			warn(
				"[GreenBedController] Soil build failed; old preview retained: "
					.. tostring(problem)
			)
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clear()
end

return Controller

--!strict
-- EditableMesh content is peer-local; restores only explicitly owned decorative MeshParts.
local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local run = game:GetService("RunService")
local world = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Geometry = require(
	storage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game"):WaitForChild("HarvestArtGeometry")
)
local Controller = { Name = "HarvestGeometryController", Order = 45 }
local PROJECT, OWNER = "children_of_corn", "harvest_warden_v1"

function Controller:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = run:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and (
			context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
			or context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "team_local"
		)
	self._connections, self._parts = {}, {}
	self._queued, self._running, self._pending = false, false, false
	self._lastError = nil
end

function Controller:_schedule()
	if not self._enabled then
		return
	end
	if self._running then
		self._pending = true
		return
	end
	if self._queued then
		return
	end
	self._queued = true
	task.defer(function()
		self._queued = false
		if self._enabled then
			self:_ensure()
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_watch(part: Instance)
	if (not part:IsA("MeshPart") and not part:IsA("Folder")) or self._parts[part] then
		return
	end
	local connections = {}
	for _, name in { "HarvestGeometryOwner", "HarvestMeshKey", "corn_project_id" } do
		table.insert(
			connections,
			part:GetAttributeChangedSignal(name):Connect(function()
				self:_schedule()
			end)
		)
	end
	if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
		table.insert(
			connections,
			part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MeshContent"):Connect(function()
				if not self._running then
					self:_schedule()
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self._parts[part] = connections
end

local function manualMap(map: Instance): boolean
	return map:GetAttribute("BManualAuthoringVersion") == 1
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
end

function Controller:_manualRestore(map: Model)
	local targets = {}
	local props, root = map:FindFirstChild("Props"), map:FindFirstChild("HarvestDecor")
	for _, part in map:GetDescendants() do
		if not part:IsA("MeshPart") then
			continue
		end
		if part:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner") ~= OWNER then
			if (props and part:IsDescendantOf(props)) or (root and part:IsDescendantOf(root)) then
				-- Farm/Harvest parts can replicate before their ownership attributes.
				-- Corn pools live outside these two authoring branches.
				self:_watch(part)
			end
			continue
		end
		self:_watch(part)
		local project, key =
			part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id"), part:GetAttribute("HarvestMeshKey")
		if project == nil or key == nil then
			continue
		end
		assert(
			project == PROJECT and type(key) == "string",
			"Foreign manual Harvest mesh preserved"
		)
		table.insert(targets, { Part = part, Key = key })
	end
	for _, target in targets do
		assert(
			map.Parent == world and manualMap(map) and target.Part:IsDescendantOf(map),
			"Manual Harvest client binding changed"
		)
		Geometry.Apply(target.Part, target.Key)
		if not self._enabled then
			return
		end
	end
end

function Controller:_ensure()
	self._running, self._pending = true, false
	local map = self._map
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		assert(
			map and map.Parent == world and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT,
			"Harvest client CornMap binding changed"
		)
		if manualMap(map) then
			self:_manualRestore(map)
			return
		end
		local root = map:FindFirstChild("HarvestDecor")
		local props = map:FindFirstChild("Props")
		local marker = props and props:FindFirstChild("ScarecrowMarker")
		local home = marker and marker:FindFirstChild("HarvestWardenHome")
		for _, visualRoot in { root, home } do
			if not visualRoot then
				continue
			end
			self:_watch(visualRoot)
			if
				visualRoot:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == nil
				or visualRoot:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner") == nil
			then
				continue
			end
			assert(
				visualRoot:IsA("Folder")
					and visualRoot:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
					and visualRoot:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner") == OWNER,
				"Foreign HarvestDecor preserved by client"
			)
			for _, part in visualRoot:GetDescendants() do
				if part:IsA("MeshPart") then
					self:_watch(part)
					local project, owner, key =
						part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id"),
						part:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner"),
						part:GetAttribute("HarvestMeshKey")
					-- Metadata can arrive after the replicated MeshPart; attribute events retry it.
					if project == nil or owner == nil or key == nil then
						continue
					end
					assert(
						project == PROJECT and owner == OWNER and type(key) == "string",
						"Foreign Harvest mesh preserved by client"
					)
					Geometry.Apply(part, key)
					if not self._enabled then
						return
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	self._running = false
	if not ok then
		local message = "[HarvestGeometryController] " .. tostring(problem)
		if message ~= self._lastError then
			warn(message)
		end
		self._lastError = message
	else
		self._lastError = nil
	end
	if self._pending then
		self:_schedule()
	end
end

function Controller:Start()
	if not self._enabled then
		return
	end
	local map = world:WaitForChild("CornMap", 10)
	assert(
		map and map:IsA("Model") and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT,
		"Harvest client CornMap unavailable"
	)
	self._map = map
	for _, attribute in { "BManualAuthoringVersion", "HarvestArtVariant" } do
		table.insert(
			self._connections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				self:_schedule()
			end)
		)
	end
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		map.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
			local root = map:FindFirstChild("HarvestDecor")
			local props = map:FindFirstChild("Props")
			local marker = props and props:FindFirstChild("ScarecrowMarker")
			local home = marker and marker:FindFirstChild("HarvestWardenHome")
			if
				(
					manualMap(map)
					and (
						item:GetAttribute("HarvestGeometryOwner") == OWNER
						or (props and item:IsDescendantOf(props))
					)
				)
				or item.Name == "HarvestDecor"
				or item.Name == "HarvestWardenHome"
				or (root and item:IsDescendantOf(root))
				or (home and item:IsDescendantOf(home))
			then
				self:_watch(item)
				self:_schedule()
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		self._connections,
		map.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(item)
			local connections = self._parts[item]
			if connections then
				for _, connection in connections do
					connection:Disconnect()
				end
				self._parts[item] = nil
			end
		end)
	)
	self:_schedule()
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	for _, connection in self._connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	for _, connections in self._parts do
		for _, connection in connections do
			connection:Disconnect()
		end
	end
	self._connections, self._parts = {}, {}
end

return Controller
